Tag på en rejse i Caravan SandWitch gennem en Provence-lignende sci-fi-verden, der drives af et mysterium om din forsvundne søster, og som udfolder sig, hver gang du tager et skridt.
 
       
 Interagér med samfundene i Cigalo, hjælp dem med deres opgaver, og mød nye mennesker på turen. Sæt tid af til at udforske verden, uanset om du kører i din autocamper eller til fods.
 
 Livet er enkelt: ingen kamp, ingen død, ingen timer. Der er kun dig, din autocamper og verden.  Udforsk en Provence-lignende verden        
 Du indleder i din autocamper og med et udvalg af vigtige værktøjer en søgen efter din forsvundne søster. Opgradér din autocamper under dit eventyr og efterforskning for at åbne nye veje og ruiner. Fra at navigere gennem vanskeligt terræn til at opdage ældgamle ruiner. Ethvert skridt på din rejse bringer dig nærmere afsløringen af sandheden bag din søsters forsvinden.  En håbefuld tid efter verdens undergang        
 Fra en grøn til en ørkenlignende planet skabt af menneskets aktiviteter og overdrevne udnyttelse. Opdag i Cigalo påvirkningen på mennesker og dets befolkning på din rejse. Mød Reinetos, der er en gammel indfødt stamme efterladt af robotterne efter udnyttelsen af planeten, menneskerne, der blev tilbage, da alle tog afsted til en anden planet, og den mystiske SandWitch. Alle lever fredeligt i Cigalo og hjælper hinanden i det barske miljø.  Mød en mangfoldig gruppe af karakterer        
 I takt med at du interagerer med disse forskellige karakterer, som du møder på din vej, får du en forståelse af, at dit samfund er dit hjem.
 
 Hjælp alle, og giv dit bidrag til projektet for at gøre det muligt for alle at leve harmonisk i et miljø, der er fjendtligt over for alle civilisationer på grund af den overdrevne udnyttelse.  Et spil, der er udviklet til alle  Det er meget vigtigt, at Plane Toast har udviklet et spil, hvor alle føler sig inkluderet, ved at præsentere deres vision af en verden, hvor samfundene hjælper hinanden med at overvinde de miljømæssige konsekvenser for vores verden. 
 Caravan SandWitch er skrevet med et inkluderende script, der udgør et ægte samfund med dets folk og repræsentation. 
 
  Tilgængelighedsindstillinger er til rådighed.

In Caravan SandWitch, intraprendi un viaggio in un mondo fantascientifico simile alla Provenza, mosso dal mistero della scomparsa di tua sorella che si svelerà passo dopo passo.
 
       
 Interagisci con le comunità di Cigalo, aiutale con le loro missioni e incontra nuove persone lungo la strada. Prendi il tempo necessario per esplorare il mondo, sia a bordo del camper che a piedi.
 
 La vita è semplice: nessun combattimento, nessuna morte, nessun cronometro. Solo tu, il tuo camper e il mondo.  Esplora un mondo simile alla Provenza        
 Grazie al tuo camper e a un arsenale di strumenti essenziali, parti alla ricerca di tua sorella scomparsa. Migliora il tuo camper procedendo nell’avventura ed esplorando, in modo da sbloccare nuovi passaggi e rovine. Dal superamento di terreni ostici alla scoperta di antiche rovine, ogni passo del tuo viaggio ti avvicinerà a scoprire la verità dietro alla scomparsa di tua sorella.  Uno scenario post-apocalittico pieno di speranza        
 Da un pianeta verde a uno desertico, causato dall’attività umana e dall’eccessivo sfruttamento; scopri l’impatto dell’uomo e della sua popolazione su Cigalo durante il tuo viaggio. Incontra i Reinetos, un’antica specie aborigena, i robot lasciati dopo lo sfruttamento del pianeta, gli umani che sono rimasti dopo che tutti sono partiti per un altro pianeta, e la misteriosa SandWitch. Tutti loro coesistono pacificamente su Cigalo, e si aiutano l’un l’altro in questo ambiente inospitale.  Incontra un insieme variegato di personaggi        
 Interagendo con i diversi personaggi che incontrerai lungo il viaggio, arriverai a capire che la tua comunità è la tua casa. 
 Aiutali tutti e contribuisci a costruire la comunità, che consentirà loro di vivere pacificamente in un ambiente ostile a tutte le civiltà a causa dell’eccessivo sfruttamento.  Un gioco sviluppato per il divertimento di tutti  Plane Toast ha dato grande importanza nel creare un gioco in cui tutti possano sentirsi inclusi, rappresentando la loro visione di un mondo dove le comunità si aiutano a vicenda per superare le problematiche ambientali del nostro mondo. 
 Caravan SandWitch è stato scritto con una sceneggiatura inclusiva, che rappresenta una comunità reale con le sue persone e le sue espressioni. 
 
  Sono disponibili opzioni di accessibilità.

game.brief: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure game.

game.title: SIGNALIS
game.description:
Searching for dreams inside of a nightmare
 	
 Awaken from slumber and explore a surreal retrotech world as Elster, a technician Replika searching for her lost partner and her lost dreams. Discover terrifying secrets, challenging puzzles, and nightmarish creatures in a tense and melancholic experience of cosmic dread and classic psychological survival horror.
 
    
       
    
    
       
 SIGNALIS is set in a dystopian future where humanity has colonized the solar system, and the totalitarian regime of Eusan maintains an iron grip through aggressive surveillance and propaganda. Humanoid androids known as Replikas live among the populace, acting as workers, civil servants, and Protektors alongside the citizens they are designed to resemble.
 
 The story of SIGNALIS begins as a Replika named Elster awakens from cryostasis in a wrecked vessel. Now stranded on a cold planet, she sets out on a journey into depths unknown.
 
    
       
       
 Experience fear and apprehension as you encounter strange horrors, carefully manage scarce resources, and seek solutions to challenging riddles.
    
       
       
 Explore the dim corners of a derelict spaceship, delve into the mysterious fate of the inhabitants of a doomed facility, and seek what lies beneath.
    
       
       
 Discover an atmospheric science-fiction tale of identity, memory, and the terror of the unknown and unknowable, inspired by classic cosmic horror and the works of Stanley Kubrick, Hideaki Anno, and David Lynch.
    
       
       
 Wander a brutalist nightmare driven by fluid 3D character animations, dynamic lights and shadows, and complex transparency effects, complemented by cinematic sci-fi anime storytelling.

À la recherche des rêves à l'intérieur du cauchemar
 	
 Éveillez-vous de votre long sommeil et explorez un monde surréaliste rétrotechnologique en tant qu'Elster, une technicienne Replika à la recherche de ses rêves oubliés. Découvrez de terrifiants secrets, des énigmes passionnantes, des créatures cauchemardesques dans cette expérience aussi mélancolique que crispante d'effroi cosmique baigné d'horreur de survie psychologique.
 
    
       
    
    
       
 SIGNALIS se déroule dans un futur dystopique où l'humanité a colonisé le système solaire, tenu d'une main de fer par le régime totalitaire eusien via sa surveillance agressive et sa propagande omniprésente. Des androïdes que l'on appelle Replikas, conçus pour ressembler aux citoyens, vivent parmi la population en tant qu'ouvriers, fonctionnaires et Protektors.
 
 L'histoire de SIGNALIS commence avec une Replika nommée Elster qui se réveille de cryostase dans une épave de vaisseau. En rade sur une planète glacée, elle entame un périple dans les profondeurs inconnues de la planète.
 
    
       
       
 Vivez en état de constante terreur devant d'étranges horreurs, gérez vos maigres ressources avec appréhension et cherchez désespérément la solution aux énigmes retorses.
    
       
       
 Explorez les coins sombres d'un vaisseau abandonné, découvrez le destin mystérieux des habitants d'une installation condamnée, et cherchez ce qui se cache derrière.
    
       
       
 Découvrez un conte évocateur de science-fiction sur l'identité, la mémoire, l'angoisse de l'inconnu, la terreur de l'inconnaissable, inspiré par l'horreur cosmique et les œuvres de Stanley Kubrick, Hideaki Anno et David Lynch.
    
       
       
 Errez dans une fable cauchemardesque à l'architecture brutaliste conduite par des animations de personnages 3D fluides, des ombres et lumières dynamiques et des effets de transparence complexes sur fond de cinématiques de science-fiction animées.

Auf der Suche nach Träumen in einem Alptraum
 
 Erwache aus dem Kälteschlaf und erkunde eine surreale Retrotech-Welt als Elster, eine Techniker-Replika, die nach ihrer verlorenen Partnerin und ihren verlorenen Träumen sucht. Stelle dich schrecklichen Geheimnissen, herausfordernden Rätseln und albtraumhaften Kreaturen in einer beklemmenden und melancholischen Erzählung, die kosmisches Grauen mit klassischem psychologischem Survival-Horror vereint.
 
    
       
    
    
       
 SIGNALIS spielt in einer dystopischen Zukunft, in der die Menschheit das Sonnensystem kolonisiert hat. Unter der eisernen Faust des totalitären Regimes von Eusan leben Menschen in einer Welt von Überwachung und Propaganda Seite an Seite mit Replikas - humanoiden Androiden, die dem Staat als Arbeiter, Beamte und Protektoren dienen.
 
 Die Geschichte von SIGNALIS beginnt, als eine Replika namens Elster in einem abgestürzten Schiff aus der Kryostase erwacht. Gestrandet auf einem kalten Planeten, begibt sie sich auf eine Reise in unbekannte Tiefen.
 
    
       
       
 Erlebe Angst und Spannung, während du seltsamen Schrecken begegnest, dir deine knappen Ressourcen sorgfältig einteilst und herausfordernde Rätsel löst.
    
       
       
 Erkunde die düsteren Ecken eines zerstörten Raumschiffs, tauche ein in das mysteriöse Schicksal der Bewohner einer dem Untergang geweihten Anlage und finde heraus, was sich tief darunter verbirgt.
    
       
       
 Verfolge eine atmosphärische Science-Fiction-Geschichte rund um Identität, Erinnerung und den Schrecken des Unbekannten und Unfassbaren, inspiriert von klassischem kosmischen Horror und den Werken von Stanley Kubrick, Hideaki Anno und David Lynch.
    
       
       
 Streife durch einen brutalistischen Alptraum, der von flüssigen 3D-Charakteranimationen, dynamischen Lichtern und Schatten und komplexen Transparenzeffekten untermalt und durch cineastisches Sci-Fi-Anime-Storytelling getragen wird.

game.title: last seen online
game.description:
You were always a snoop, weren’t you? That’s why you bought an old computer you saw lying among piles of junk at a garage sale. You didn’t even bother to format the computer before you turned it on. You were curious. After all, a personal computer is an extension of another person’s soul, all their secrets, projects, interactions.
 

 
“last seen online” is a psychological horror escape room, based on early flash games. Look through someone's computer files. Solve puzzles and discover the secrets that lie within the computer.

game.title: Splatoon
game.description:
Splatoon is primarily a team-based third-person shooter which is playable by up to eight players in 4-vs-4 matches, although the game also features a single-player campaign. Players control characters called Inklings, wich can change between human form and squid form. Transforming into a squid allows players to swim through ink of their own color, even up walls and through grates, hiding from the enemy and replenishing their ink supply in the process.

After the Great Zapfish, Inkopolis' primary power supply, is stolen, Cap'n Cuttlefish employs a Splatoon of Inklings to travel to the Octarians' secret underground base and retrieve it. Players assume the role of Agent 3 of the New Squidbeak Splatoon and traverse the treacherous landscape of Octo Valley in order to reclaim various lost Zapfish, Sunken Scrolls, and Power Eggs.

game.title: Catgirl
game.description:
Welcome to Catgirl. In this RPG, you control a cat whose dog gets kidnapped by an evil demon queen. Now you must rescue your best friend... and maybe some other ppl too.
  
features:    
• Story focused game play (but you can body slam absent fathers too).
• Short & sweet, just a couple hours.
• Lots of mini-games
    • Charming original art and soundtrack..
   • Idiot-rich story with an emphasis on humor and pain.
   • Created by 3 people, that's over 2 brains worth of game.
   • Be friends with an orange doggy named Mopmop.
   • You can make beats with a caveman.
   • There's a really handsome guy in the game
   • Sometimes i can't help but feel like a failure, no matter how hard i try
   • Super fun epic adventure filled with fantasy and friends!!!

game.title: Detective Grimoire
game.description:
Detective Grimoire has been called to investigate a murder. The owner of a small tourist attraction, found deep within the heart of the marshes, seemingly killed by the very mythical creature his attraction is based around... Explore the surrounding area, inspect the scene of the crime, grill the suspects, solve puzzles, search for clues and uncover the secret of the swamp! 
 
  Features 
   A mixture of investigating and puzzle gameplay, designed with mouse/touch in mind 
   Assemble Grimoire's thoughts to reach conclusions about the case 
   A fully voiced and animated cast of characters to interrogate 
   Beautiful digitally painted environments to explore 
   Award nominated original orchestral soundtrack

game.title: Kathy Rain: Director's Cut
game.description:
Kathy Rain: Director's Cut is a re-imagining of the classic 2016 point-and-click detective mystery set in the '90s.
 
 In this investigative thriller, you will do things like:
   Collect clues and make deductions
   Analyze evidence
   Interrogate suspects
   Solve cryptic puzzles  
 All while moving from location to location on your sweet hog and getting into all sorts of trouble!
 
       
 
 Kathy is a strong-willed journalism major who must come to terms with her troubled past as she investigates the mysterious death of her recently departed grandfather.
 
 Armed with her motorcycle, a pack of cigs, and a notepad, Kathy delves into a local mystery surrounding her hometown that will take her on a harrowing journey of emotional and personal turmoil.
 
 As she follows a trail of clues left by her grandfather, questions emerge: What was Joseph Rain really looking for that night all those years ago? What turned him into a mere shell of a man, confined to a wheelchair? What secret did a suicidal young artist take with her to the grave, and why are so many people in Conwell Springs going mad? The truth is dark, sinister, and yours to uncover…
 
        Original Kathy Rain Features:   Compelling narrative with an eerie plot set in the '90s
   Gorgeous pixel art displayed in 40+ hand-drawn environments
   4,000+ lines of fully voiced dialogue directed by Wadjet Eye Games' Dave Gilbert
   Atmospheric original soundtrack   Director's Cut Introduces:   Extended storyline, including a longer and more satisfying ending and 700+ new lines of dialogue with the original cast
   Several new areas to explore with unique puzzles to solve
   Streamlined controls with a single-click mouse interface and controller support
   Enlarged all game environments for widescreen without black bars on the sides
   Extra character animations, improved lighting/shadows and better weather effects
   Remixed and expanded soundtrack
   Five brand new motorcycle designs to unlock

Kathy Rain: Director's Cut es un rediseño de la clásica aventura gráfica de detectives de 2016, ambientada en los 90.
 
 Métete en la piel de Kathy en este thriller detectivesco:
   Reúne pistas y haz deducciones
   Analiza pruebas
   Interroga a sospechosos
   Resuelve enigmáticos puzles  
 ¡Y todo ello mientras te desplazas de un sitio a otro en una moto espectacular y te metes en toda clase de líos!
 
       
 
 Kathy es una periodista muy entregada que debe investigar la reciente y misteriosa muerte de su abuelo, a la vez que hace las paces con un pasado turbulento.
 
 Armada con su moto, un paquete de cigarrillos y un cuaderno, profundiza en un misterio local que afecta a su ciudad natal y emprende un desgarrador viaje de descubrimiento emocional y personal.
 
 Mientras sigue el rastro de pistas que dejó su abuelo, van surgiendo preguntas. ¿Qué buscaba en realidad Joseph Rain aquella noche de hace tantos años? ¿Cómo llegó a convertirse en poco más que el cascarón de un hombre, atado a una silla de ruedas? ¿Qué secreto se llevó a la tumba una joven artista suicida? ¿Por qué está enloqueciendo tanta gente en Conwell Springs? La verdad es oscura, siniestra y está esperando a que la descubras...
 
        En la versión original de Kathy Rain encontrarás:   Una emocionante narrativa con una trama inquietante ambientada en los 90
   Un bellísimo estilo artístico pixelado de baja resolución en más de 40 escenarios dibujados a mano
   Más de 4000 líneas de diálogo totalmente dobladas bajo la dirección de Dave Gilbert, de Wadjet Eye Games
   La evocadora banda sonora original   La edición Director's Cut añade todo esto:   Una historia ampliada, con un final más largo y satisfactorio y más de 700 líneas de diálogo nuevas del elenco original.
   Varias zonas nuevas que explorar, con puzles únicos que pondrán a prueba tu ingenio.
   Controles optimizados con una interfaz de ratón basada en un solo clic y compatibilidad con mandos.
   Entornos de juego ampliados para aprovechar las pantallas panorámicas sin bandas negras a los lados.
   Más animaciones para los personajes, mejoras en las luces y sombras y efectos climatológicos perfeccionados.
   Banda sonora remezclada y ampliada.
   Cinco diseños de moto totalmente nuevos que puedes desbloquear.

Kathy Rain: Director's Cut ist die überarbeitete Version des in den 1990ern angesiedelten Point-and-Click-Klassikers mit Mystery-Touch von 2016.
 
 In diesem Detektivkrimi wirst du:
   Hinweise sammeln und Schlussfolgerungen treffen
   Beweise untersuchen
   Verdächtige Personen befragen
   Geheimnisvolle Rätsel lösen  
 Und all das, während du auf deinem heißen Ofen von Ort zu Ort donnerst und dabei in allerlei Schwierigkeiten gerätst!
 
       
 
 Kathy Rain ist eine willensstarke Journalismusstudentin, die sich mit ihrer bewegten Vergangenheit auseinandersetzen muss, als sie den mysteriösen Tod ihres kürzlich verstorbenen Großvaters untersucht.
 
 Ausgestattet mit ihrem Motorrad, einer Packung Zigaretten und einem Notizblock taucht Kathy in ein Geheimnis rund um ihre Heimatstadt ein und begibt sich auf eine erschütternde Reise voller emotionaler und persönlicher Wirren.
 
 Als sie der Spur aus Hinweisen folgt, die ihr Großvater hinterlassen hat, tauchen viele Fragen auf: Wonach hat Joseph Rain in jener Nacht vor all den Jahren wirklich gesucht? Warum war er danach nur noch ein Schatten seiner selbst und an einen Rollstuhl gefesselt? Welches Geheimnis hat eine junge Kunststudentin nach ihrem Selbstmord mit ins Grab genommen, und warum werden so viele Bewohner von Conwell Springs verrückt? Die Wahrheit ist düster und unheimlich und wartet darauf, von dir ans Licht gebracht zu werden ...
        Besondere Merkmale des ursprünglichen Kathy Rain:   Eine packende und geheimnisvolle Geschichte in den 1990ern
   Fantastische Pixel-Art-Grafik mit über 40 handgezeichneten Umgebungen
   Über 4.000 Zeilen gesprochener Dialog unter der Regie von Dave Gilbert von Wadjet Eye Games
   Atmosphärisch dichter Original-Soundtrack   Der Director's Cut fügt hinzu:   Erweiterte Handlung mit verlängertem und befriedigenderem Ende sowie mehr als 700 neuen Dialogzeilen mit der ursprünglichen Besetzung
   Mehrere neue Umgebungen zum Erkunden sowie neue einzigartige Rätsel
   Vereinfachte Steuerung mit Ein-Klick-Oberfläche für Maus und Controller-Unterstützung
   Vergrößerte Spielumgebungen füllen den gesamten Bildschirm in Breitbildauflösung ohne schwarze Balken an den Rändern
   Zusätzliche Charakteranimationen, verbesserte Licht- und Schatteneffekte und bessere Wettereffekte
   Erweiterter und neu abgemischter Soundtrack
   Fünf brandneue Motorraddesigns zum Freischalten

Passado nos anos 90, Kathy Rain conta a história de uma estudante de jornalismo determinada que tem de se reconciliar com o seu passado problemático, ao mesmo tempo que investiga a recente e misteriosa morte do seu avô. 
 
  ""Conwell Springs. Nunca pensei que ia voltar a este sítio..."" 
 Armada com a sua mota, um maço de cigarros e um caderno, Kathy investiga num mistério local que gira em torno da sua terra natal e que a vai levar por uma viagem angustiante de tumulto emocional e pessoal.
 
  ""Eu... sinto-me estranha. Estarei a sonhar?"" 
 À medida que segue o trilho de pistas deixado pelo seu avô, começam a surgir questões: De que é que Joseph Rain estava realmente à procura naquela noite há tantos anos atrás? O que é que o transformou numa sombra de homem, confinado a uma cadeira de rodas? Que segredo é que uma jovem artista suicida levou com ela para o túmulo e porque é que tanta gente em Conwell Springs está a enlouquecer? A verdade é sombria, sinistra e cabe-te a ti desvendá-la... Caraterísticas do Director's Cut:   História expandida com um final maior, centenas de linhas de diálogo adicionais e várias novas áreas para explorar.
   Várias sequências de puzzles adicionais e muitas pequenas adições e melhorias aos puzzles existentes.
   Todos os ambientes do jogo foram ampliados para preencherem todo o ecrã inteiro em resoluções de widescreen, sem caixas pretas laterais.
   Foram feitas inúmeras melhorias visuais, tais como mais animações de personagens, melhores luzes/sombras melhores e efeitos climáticos adicionais.
   Os controlos do rato foram simplificados com uma interface intuitiva de um só clique.
   Suporte para comandos como deve ser. Relaxa na cadeira e controla Kathy de forma direta e simples, sem um cursor a atrapalhar.
   Banda sonora expandida e remisturada por Daniel Kobylarz, o compositor original.
   Cinco novos designs de mota para desbloquear e personalizar a Katmobile.   Caraterísticas:   Uma narrativa interessante passada nos anos 90 e com um enredo arrepiante
   Pixel art lindíssima
   Mais de 40 ambientes desenhados à mão
   Mais de 4.000 linhas de diálogo faladas
   Dobragem inglesa dirigida por Dave Gilbert, da Wadjet Eye Games
   Banda sonora original atmosférica

game.title: Assassin's Creed
game.description:
Assassin's Creed is a non-linear action-adventure video game, during which the player controls a 12th-century Levantine Assassin named Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad during the Third Crusade, whose life is experienced through the Animus by his 21st century descendant, Desmond Miles.

Desmond Miles, a bartender, is kidnapped by the company Abstergo Industries for use as a test subject in the "Animus," a device that can simulate genetic memory. Abstergo intends to put Desmond in the device to recall the memories of his ancestor, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad, a member of the Assassin Brotherhood in the year 1191, who lived during the Third Crusade in the Holy Land. Initially, Desmond has trouble adjusting to the device, but eventually relives Altaïr's exploits over the next several days. The game then primarily changes to Altaïr's point-of-view, with occasional transitions to Desmond, due to problems with the Animus or onset of the Bleeding Effect.

The game opens with Desmond entering Altaïr's memory, but he soon faces synchronization problems. On this, Lucy Stillman and Warren Vidic's voices can be heard, arguing over Desmond's safety within the Animus. After experiencing a few problems, Desmond exits the virtual machine and Vidic briefs him about the Animus' inner workings, before initializing the machine's tutorial program. After Desmond is done with the tutorial, he enters the closest synchronizable memory of Altaïr; Lucy adds that Desmond has to relive key moments of Altaïr's life to increase his synchronization, before reaching the final memory which holds the information that Abstergo is seeking.

Altaïr is first shown attempting to retrieve one of a series of artifacts known as the "Pieces of Eden" from Solomon's Temple with the help of Malik Al-Sayf, and his brother Kadar, but they are stopped by Robert de Sablé, Grand Master of the Knights Templar and sworn enemy of the Assassins. While retrieving the treasure, Altaïr breaks all three tenets of the Assassins' Creed in an attempt to kill Robert, but he ultimately fails. In the following commotion, Malik's brother is killed, and Malik's left arm is crippled and later amputated. When Altaïr returns to the Assassins' stronghold at Masyaf with apologies, Malik, who survived de Sablé, comes back with the artifact and disparages Altaïr because of his arrogance.

After narrowly defeating a retaliatory attack by the Templars, Al Mualim, leader of the Assassins, demotes Altaïr to a novice but gives him another chance to rise through the ranks of the Brotherhood. Al Mualim assigns Altaïr the task of assassinating nine key figures across the Holy Land in Jerusalem, Acre and Damascus, aiming to bring peace between the Crusader and Saracen forces. Each target is based on an actual historical figure from the Third Crusade, including Majd Addin, Garnier de Naplouse, Jubair al Hakim, Abu'l Nuqoud, Sibrand, William of Montferrat, and Robert de Sablé.

Altaïr completes each task, learning how each target is connected to Robert and the Templars and how together they aim to end the Crusades and place the Holy Land under their own control. With men on both sides killed, he discovers that Robert's last plot is to attempt to unite the Christian and Muslim forces against their new common enemy, the Assassins themselves. Altaïr defeats de Sablé before Richard the Lionheart, failing to convince the King that an end to the war would be welcome to both sides, but ending Robert's plot. From de Sablé, Altaïr discovers that Al Mualim was himself a member of the Templars and used the Assassin to kill the other members who held the secret to the treasure's power, so that he could selfishly keep the artifact for himself.

Altaïr quickly returns to Masyaf and approaches his master, who reveals the truth to him: the Piece of Eden, which he had recovered through the help of Altaïr directly before his transgression, creates illusions. He denounces religion and other seemingly supernatural events (e.g. the Ten Plagues of Egypt, the parting of the Red Sea, and the presence of the Greek Gods in the Trojan War) as illusions caused by the Piece, and then states his intention to use the artifact to compel mankind into a brainwashed state, and in doing so, bringing an end to all conflict; Altaïr is eventually able to see through the deceptions created by the artifact to kill Al Mualim. When Altaïr recovers the artifact, the Piece of Eden activates, showing a holographic view of the world with numerous locations of other Pieces of Eden marked across the globe.

When the process is complete, Desmond learns that Abstergo is a modern-day front of the Templars, and they are already seeking other artifacts at locations identified in Altaïr's memories. Further, he learns that the modern-day Assassins had tried to rescue him before the memory had completed but had failed. Following this, Desmond was to be killed after an order from a high-ranking Templar, Alan Rikkin, but Lucy Stillman saves him from death and, at one point, tucks her ring finger into her palm, referring to the Assassins' tradition of cutting off the finger.

Though Desmond remains trapped in the Abstergo laboratory, his experience in the Animus has created a Bleeding Effect of Altaïr's life in his own, allowing Desmond to use Altaïr's Eagle Vision, which, in turn, allows him to see strange messages painted on the walls of his room and the floor of the lab. The messages all deal with various forms of the end of the world from different cultures, including several references to 21 December 2012, the date that Abstergo plans to launch a satellite that will "permanently end the war." It is hinted that this method would be by the same method that Al Mualim hypnotized Masyaf, only on a larger scale. Finally, the game ends with Desmond wondering what the images all mean and who could have drawn them.

Abstergo intends to put Desmond in the device to recall the memories of his ancestor, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad, a member of the Assassin Brotherhood in the year 1191, who lived during the Third Crusade in the Holy Land. Initially, Desmond has trouble adjusting to the device, but eventually relives Altaïr's exploits over the next several days. The game then primarily changes to Altaïr's point-of-view, with occasional transitions to Desmond, due to problems with the Animus or onset of the Bleeding Effect.

The game opens with Desmond entering Altaïr's memory, but he soon faces synchronization problems. On this, Lucy Stillman and Warren Vidic's voices can be heard, arguing over Desmond's safety within the Animus. After experiencing a few problems, Desmond exits the virtual machine and Vidic briefs him about the Animus' inner workings, before initializing the machine's tutorial program. After Desmond is done with the tutorial, he enters the closest synchronizable memory of Altaïr; Lucy adds that Desmond has to relive key moments of Altaïr's life to increase his synchronization, before reaching the final memory which holds the information that Abstergo is seeking.

Altaïr is first shown attempting to retrieve one of a series of artifacts known as the "Pieces of Eden" from Solomon's Temple with the help of Malik Al-Sayf, and his brother Kadar, but they are stopped by Robert de Sablé, Grand Master of the Knights Templar and sworn enemy of the Assassins. While retrieving the treasure, Altaïr breaks all three tenets of the Assassins' Creed in an attempt to kill Robert, but he ultimately fails. In the following commotion, Malik's brother is killed, and Malik's left arm is crippled and later amputated. When Altaïr returns to the Assassins' stronghold at Masyaf with apologies, Malik, who survived de Sablé, comes back with the artifact and disparages Altaïr because of his arrogance.

After narrowly defeating a retaliatory attack by the Templars, Al Mualim, leader of the Assassins, demotes Altaïr to a novice but gives him another chance to rise through the ranks of the Brotherhood. Al Mualim assigns Altaïr the task of assassinating nine key figures across the Holy Land in Jerusalem, Acre and Damascus, aiming to bring peace between the Crusader and Saracen forces. Each target is based on an actual historical figure from the Third Crusade, including Majd Addin, Garnier de Naplouse, Jubair al Hakim, Abu'l Nuqoud, Sibrand, William of Montferrat, and Robert de Sablé.

Altaïr completes each task, learning how each target is connected to Robert and the Templars and how together they aim to end the Crusades and place the Holy Land under their own control. With men on both sides killed, he discovers that Robert's last plot is to attempt to unite the Christian and Muslim forces against their new common enemy, the Assassins themselves. Altaïr defeats de Sablé before Richard the Lionheart, failing to convince the King that an end to the war would be welcome to both sides, but ending Robert's plot. From de Sablé, Altaïr discovers that Al Mualim was himself a member of the Templars and used the Assassin to kill the other members who held the secret to the treasure's power, so that he could selfishly keep the artifact for himself.

Altaïr quickly returns to Masyaf and approaches his master, who reveals the truth to him: the Piece of Eden, which he had recovered through the help of Altaïr directly before his transgression, creates illusions. He denounces religion and other seemingly supernatural events (e.g. the Ten Plagues of Egypt, the parting of the Red Sea, and the presence of the Greek Gods in the Trojan War) as illusions caused by the Piece, and then states his intention to use the artifact to compel mankind into a brainwashed state, and in doing so, bringing an end to all conflict; Altaïr is eventually able to see through the deceptions created by the artifact to kill Al Mualim. When Altaïr recovers the artifact, the Piece of Eden activates, showing a holographic view of the world with numerous locations of other Pieces of Eden marked across the globe.

When the process is complete, Desmond learns that Abstergo is a modern-day front of the Templars, and they are already seeking other artifacts at locations identified in Altaïr's memories. Further, he learns that the modern-day Assassins had tried to rescue him before the memory had completed but had failed. Following this, Desmond was to be killed after an order from a high-ranking Templar, Alan Rikkin, but Lucy Stillman saves him from death and, at one point, tucks her ring finger into her palm, referring to the Assassins' tradition of cutting off the finger.

Though Desmond remains trapped in the Abstergo laboratory, his experience in the Animus has created a Bleeding Effect of Altaïr's life in his own, allowing Desmond to use Altaïr's Eagle Vision, which, in turn, allows him to see strange messages painted on the walls of his room and the floor of the lab. The messages all deal with various forms of the end of the world from different cultures, including several references to 21 December 2012, the date that Abstergo plans to launch a satellite that will "permanently end the war." It is hinted that this method would be by the same method that Al Mualim hypnotized Masyaf, only on a larger scale. Finally, the game ends with Desmond wondering what the images all mean and who could have drawn them.

Assassin's Creed™ is the next-gen game developed by Ubisoft Montreal that redefines the action genre. While other games claim to be next-gen with impressive graphics and physics, Assassin's Creed merges technology, game design, theme and emotions into a world where you instigate chaos and become a vulnerable, yet powerful, agent of change.
 					The setting is 1191 AD. The Third Crusade is tearing the Holy Land apart. You, Altair, intend to stop the hostilities by suppressing both sides of the conflict.
 					You are an Assassin, a warrior shrouded in secrecy and feared for your ruthlessness. Your actions can throw your immediate environment into chaos, and your existence will shape events during this pivotal moment in history.
 					   Be an Assassin  - Master the skills, tactics and weapons of history's deadliest and most secretive clan of warriors. Plan your attacks, strike without mercy and fight your way to escape.
 					   Experience exclusive PC content  - Four PC-exclusive investigation missions make the game an even better experience than its console predecessors, including the Rooftop Race Challenge, a race to a specified location and the Archer Stealth Assassination Challenge, where the player must assassinate all archers in a certain zone to help out fellow Assassins.
 					   Realistic and responsive environments  - Experience a living, breathing world in which all your actions have consequences. Crowds react to your moves and will either help or hinder you on your quests.
 					   Action with a new dimension-total freedom  - Eliminate your targets wherever, whenever and however. Stalk your prey through richly detailed, historically accurate, open-ended environments. Scale buildings, mount horses, blend in with crowds. Do whatever it takes to achieve your objectives.
 					   Relive the epic times of the Crusades  - Assassin's Creed immerses you in the realistic and historical Holy Land of the 12th century, featuring life-like graphics, ambience and the subtle, yet detailed nuances of a living world.
 					   Intense action rooted in reality  - Experience heavy action blended with fluid and precise animations. Use a wide range of medieval weapons, and face your enemies in realistic swordfight duels.
 					   Next-gen gameplay  - The proprietary engine developed from the ground up for the next-gen console allows organic game design featuring open gameplay, intuitive control scheme, realistic interaction with environment and a fluid, yet sharp, combat mechanic.

Assassin's Creed™ es el juego de nueva generación desarrollado por Ubisoft Montreal que redefine el género de acción. Mientras que otros juegos presumen de ser de nueva generación con impresionantes gráficos y física, Assassin's Creed fusiona tecnología, diseño de juego, temas y emociones en un mundo donde siembras el caos y te conviertes en un vulnerable, pero poderoso, agente de cambio.
 Estamos en el año 1191 d.C., y la Tercera Cruzada está asolando la Tierra Santa. Tú, Altair, intentarás poner fin a las hostilidades eliminando ambas partes del conflicto.
 Eres un Asesino, un guerrero envuelto en un halo de misterio y temido por tu crueldad. Tus acciones pueden sembrar el caos en tu entorno más cercano y tu existencia dará forma a los acontecimientos durante este momento clave de la historia.
    Sé un Asesino  - Domina las habilidades, tácticas y armas del clan de guerreros más mortal y secreto de la historia. Planifica tus ataques, golpea sin piedad y emprende la lucha para escapar
    Experimenta el contenido exclusivo para PC  - Cuatro misiones de investigación exclusivas para PC amplían la experiencia de juego más allá de las versiones precedentes para consola a través de desafíos como Carreras por los Tejados, una carrera a un lugar específico, y Asesinato Sigiloso de Arqueros, donde los jugadores deberán asesinar a todos los arqueros de una determinada zona para ayudar a los Asesinos
    Entornos realistas e interactivos  - Experimenta un mundo vivo que respira por sí mismo y en el que tus acciones tienen consecuencias. La multitud reacciona ante tus movimientos y puede ayudarte en tu misión o entorpecer tu avance
    Acción en una nueva dimensión de libertad total  - Elimina a tus objetivos donde, cuando y como quieras. Sigue a tu presa a través de entornos con gran nivel de detalle e históricamente exactos. Escala edificios, monta a caballo, mézclate con la multitud. Haz lo que sea necesario para lograr tus objetivos
    Revive los momentos épicos de las Cruzadas  - Assassin's Creed te sumerge en la histórica Tierra Santa del siglo XII, con gráficos y ambientes realistas, además de los sutiles, pero detallados, matices de un mundo vivo
    Acción intensa basada en la realidad  - Siente la acción más trepidante combinada con animaciones fluidas y precisas. Utiliza un amplia variedad de armas medievales y enfréntate a tus enemigos en duelos a espada de lo más realista
    Sistema de juego de nueva generación  - El motor propietario desarrollado desde cero para las consolas de nueva generación posibilita un diseño orgánico para que disfrutes de un juego abierto, sistemas de control intuitivos, interacción realista con el entorno y una mecánica de combate fluida y precisa

Assassin’s Creed™ est un jeu de nouvelle génération développé par Ubisoft Montréal qui redéfinit le genre du jeu d'action. Alors que d'autres jeux se réclament de la nouvelle génération en se basant sur le graphisme, Assassin’s Creed mélange lui technologie, design, thématique et émotion dans un monde où règne le chaos.
 1191, la troisième croisade déferle sur le proche orient. Vous êtes Altair et vous allez essayer de mettre un terme au conflit qui ravage la Terre Sainte.
 Vous êtes un Assassin, le guerrier d'un ordre secret réputé pour ses méthodes expéditives. Vos actions et votre présence pèseront sur les événements historiques qui se déroulent sous vos yeux.
    Soyez un Assassin  - Maîtriser l'art et la manière de faire partie du clan de guerriers le plus redouté d'entre tous. Frappez au moment opportun et disparaissez sans laisser de traces.
    Contenu exclusif PC  - 4 missions inédites et exclusives pour la version PC. Parmi ces missions : la course sur les toits, l'assassinat des archers... 
    Environnement réaliste  - Tout un monde s'ouvre à vous : chacune de vos actions aura des conséquences. La foule réagira en fonction de vos choix et de votre progression.
    Nouveau type d'action avec une liberté quasi totale  – Éliminez vos cibles comment, quand et où vous le souhaitez. Filez votre proie dans les décors ouverts, escaladez les bâtiments, chevauchez, mêlez-vous à la foule... bref, faites ce qu'il faut pour réussir votre mission.
    Vivez au temps des Croisés  - Plongez au cœur du XIIème siècle et parcourez la Terre Sainte d'alors.
    Action intense  - Animations rapides et fluides, utilisez tout un arsenal d'armes médiévales pour défier vos adversaires.
    Jouabilité nouvelle génération  - un moteur graphique tout nouveau a été développé pour l'occasion. Contrôles intuitifs, interactions réalistes, environnement fluide et mécanique de combat font de ce jeu une expérience unique.

Assassin’s Creed™ ist das Action-Game der nächsten Generation aus dem Hause Ubisoft Montreal und wird das Genre neu definieren. Während andere Spiele behaupten durch noch beeindruckendere Grafik und Physikeffekte 'next-gen' zu sein, verbindet Assassin’s Creed Technologie, Spieldesign, Spielmotiv und Emotionen in eine Welt, in der Sie ein Komplize des Chaos sind und zu einem verwundbaren, jedoch äußerst mächtigen Zünglein an der Waage der Geschichte werden.
 Wir schreiben das Jahr 1191 AD. Der Dritte Kreuzzug spaltet das Heilige Land. Sie, Altair, beabsichtigen die Feindseligkeiten auf beiden Seiten des Konflikts einzudämmen.
 Sie sind ein Assassine, ein verdeckt operierender Kämpfer, gefürchtet für Ihre Schonungslosigkeit. Ihre Taten stürzen Ihre unmittelbare Umwelt in heilloses Chaos und Ihr Tun und Schaffen wird die Ereignisse dieser historischen Periode maßgeblich beeinflussen.
    Werden Sie zum Assassine  - Meistern Sie die notwendigen Fähigkeiten, Taktiken und Waffen eines der historisch blutigsten und ruchlosesten Geheimbundes perfektionierter Kämpfer. Planen Sie Ihre Angriffe sorgfältig, schlagen Sie gnadenlos zu und fliehen Sie entlang Ihrer Fluchtroute.
    Erleben Sie exklusiven PC Inhalt  - Vier Untersuchungsmissionen exklusiv für den PC warten auf Sie, inklusive der 'Rooftop Race Herausforderung', einem Rennen zu einem bestimmten Unterschlupf und die 'Archer Stealth Assassination Herausforderung', in der Spieler alle Bogenschützen ausschalten müssen.
    Realistische und reagierende Umwelt  - In dieser detailreichen und atemberaubenden Welt haben alle Taten Konsequenzen. Die Mengen reagieren auf all Ihre Schritte und werden Sie auf Ihren Missionen entweder hindern oder Ihnen Schutz bieten.
    Action mit einer noch nie dagewesenen Freiheit  – Eliminieren Sie Ihre Ziele wo, wann und vor allem wie Sie wollen. Verfolgen Sie Ihre Ziele durch detailreiche, historisch akkurate, offene Umwelten. Klettern Sie an Häuserfassaden hinauf, nutzen Sie Pferde, nehmen Sie in Menschenmengen Deckung und erledigen Sie Ihr Ziel, koste es, was es wolle.
    Durchleben Sie dieses epische Zeitalter der Kreuzzüge  - Assassin’s Creed bietet Ihnen hautnah und äußerst realistisch das historische Heilige Land des 12. Jahrhunderts - lebensechte Grafik und Atmosphäre und all die kleinen, aber feinen, Nuancen einer lebendigen Welt.
    Intensivste Action mit geschichtlichen Wurzeln  - Flüssige und präzise Animationen paaren sich mit Action der Superlative. Bedienen Sie sich aus einem Arsenal mittelalterlicher Waffen und bezwingen Sie Ihre Feinde in realistischen Schwertgefechten.
    Ein Spielerlebnis der nächsten Generation  - Die patentierte Engine dieses Spiels wurde extra für Konsolenspiele der nächsten Generation entwickelt und bietet lebendiges Spieldesign mit offenen Verlauf, intuitiver Steuerung und realistischen Interaktionen mit der Umwelt, sowie ein flüssiges, exaktes Kampfsystem.

Assassin's Creed™ er næste generations spil udviklet af Ubisoft Montreal, og som redefinerer actiongenren. Mens andre spil hævder at tilhøre næste generation med imponerende grafik og fysik, blander Assassin's Creed teknologi, spildesign, tema, og følelser ind i en verden, hvor du ansporer til kaos og bliver en sårbar men magtfuld ændringens mand.
 					Spillet foregår i 1191 efter vor tidsregning Det tredje korstog er ved at rive det hellige land fra hinanden. Du, Altair, har til hensigt at stoppe fjendtlighederne ved at holde begge sider af konflikten nede.
 					Du er en Assassin, en kriger, der er omgivet af hemmeligheder og frygtet for ubønhørlighed. Dine handlinger kan forårsage øjeblikkeligt kaos i miljøet, og din eksistens former begivenhederne i dette vigtige øjeblik af historien.
 					   Vær en Assassin  - får styr på evnerne, taktikkerne og våbnene bag historiens dødeligste og mest hemmelighedsomspundne krigerklan. Planlæg dine angreb, slå til uden nåde, og kæmp din vej frem for at flygte.
 					   Oplev eksklusivt pc-indhold  - fire undersøgelsesmissioner til pc gør spillet til en endnu bedre oplevelse end dets konsolforgængere, inkl. Rooftop Race Challenge, et racerløb til en bestemt lokation, samt Archer Stealth Assassination Challenge, hvor spilleren skal snigmyrde alle skytter i en bestemt zone for at hjælpe sine snigmorderekollegaer ud.
 					   Realistiske og modtagelige omgivelser  - oplev en levende, åndende verden, hvor alle dine handlinger har konsekvenser. Masserne reagerer på dine handlinger og vil enten hjælpe dig eller stå i vejen for dig på dine togter.
 					   Action med en ny dimension: Total frihed  - udslet dine mål, hvor som helst, når som helst og på en hvilken som helst måde. Jag dit bytte gennem rigt detaljerede, historisk nøjagtige frit farbare miljøer. Indtag bygninger, bestig heste, og fald ind i masserne. Gør, hvad der er nødvendigt for at nå dine mål.
 					   Genoplev korstogenes episke tider  - Assassin's Creed omslutter dig i det 12. århundredes realistiske og historiske Hellige Land med levende grafik, atmosfære og subtile men detaljerede nuancer fra en levende verden.
 					   Intens action med rødder i virkeligheden  - oplev storstilet action blandet med flydende og præcise animationer. Gør brug af et bredt udvalg af middelaldervåben, og bekæmp dine fjender i realistiske sværdkampe.
 					   Næste generations gameplay  - den egenudviklede motor, der er udviklet fra bunden til næste generations konsol, muliggør organisk spildesign med åbent gameplay, intuitiv kontrol, realistisk interaktion med miljø samt et flydende men skarpt kampelement.

Assassin's Creed™ è il gioco di nuova generazione sviluppato da Ubisoft Montreal che ridefinisce il genere azione. Mentre altri giochi si proclamano di nuova generazione per via di grafiche e fisica impressionanti, Assassin's Creed unisce tecnologia, design, temi ed emozioni in un mondo dove tu puoi generare il caos e diventare un vulnerabile, ma potente, portatore di cambiamenti.
 Corre l'anno 1191. La Terza Crociata sta lacerando la Terra Santa. Tu, Altair, hai l'intenzione di fermare le ostilità eliminando entrambi gli schieramenti del conflitto.
 Tu sei un Assassino, un guerriero avvolto dal mistero e temuto per la tua spietatezza. Le tue azioni possono creare il panico nel tuo ambiente circostante, e la tua esistenza condizionerà gli eventi durante questo momento cruciale della storia.
    Diventa un Assassino  - Padroneggia abilità, tattiche e armi del clan di guerrieri più segreto e letale della storia. Pianifica i tuoi attacchi, colpisci senza pietà e combatti per creare la tua via di fuga.
    Contenuto esclusivo per PC  - Quattro esclusive missioni di investigazione per PC rendono il gioco un'esperienza migliore rispetto al suo predecessore per console, come la sfida "Corsa sui Tetti", una corsa verso una specifica località e la sfida " Assassinio Furtivo di Arcieri", nella quale il giocatore deve eliminare tutti gli arcieri in una zona precisa per aiutare i compagni Assassini.
    Ambienti realistici e interattivi  - Sperimenta un mondo vivo nel quale tutte le tue azioni hanno conseguenze. Le folle reagiscono ai tuoi movimenti e potranno sia aiutarti sia ostacolarti nelle tue missioni.
     Azioni in una nuova dimensione di totale libertà  - Elimina i tuoi bersagli dove, quando e come vuoi. Insegui la tua preda attraverso ambienti riccamente dettagliati, accurati dal punto di vista storico e liberi di essere esplorati. Arrampicati sugli edifici, monta cavalli, mimetizzati nella folla. Esegui tutto ciò che serve per ottenere i tuoi obiettivi.
    Rivivi l'epico periodo delle Crociate  - Assassin's Creed ti immerge nella realistica e storica Terra Santa del 12° secolo, con grafiche e ambienti realistici e le sottili, ma dettagliate sfumature di un mondo vivo.
    Azione intensa basata sulla realtà  - Vivi un'azione frenetica unita ad animazioni fluide e precise. Usa un'ampia gamma di armi medievali e affronta i tuoi nemici in realistici duelli a colpi di spada.
    Gameplay di nuova generazione  - Il motore grafico sviluppato per le console di nuova generazione permette un design di gioco organico caratterizzato da un gameplay aperto e libero, da un sistema di controllo intuitivo, da interazioni realistiche con l'ambiente circostante e da una meccanica di combattimento fluida e nitida.

Further, he learns that the modern-day Assassins had tried to rescue him before the memory had completed but had failed. Following this, Desmond was to be killed after an order from a high-ranking Templar, Alan Rikkin, but Lucy Stillman saves him from death and, at one point, tucks her ring finger into her palm, referring to the Assassins' tradition of cutting off the finger.

Though Desmond remains trapped in the Abstergo laboratory, his experience in the Animus has created a Bleeding Effect of Altaïr's life in his own, allowing Desmond to use Altaïr's Eagle Vision, which, in turn, allows him to see strange messages painted on the walls of his room and the floor of the lab. The messages all deal with various forms of the end of the world from different cultures, including several references to 21 December 2012, the date that Abstergo plans to launch a satellite that will "permanently end the war." It is hinted that this method would be by the same method that Al Mualim hypnotized Masyaf, only on a larger scale. Finally, the game ends with Desmond wondering what the images all mean and who could have drawn them.

game.title: Assassin's Creed Unity
game.description:
A RUTHLESS NEW HERO FOR A BRUTAL NEW WORLD  
Play as Arno, an entirely new breed of Assassin more lethal than his ancestors. Take down your prey with a range of new weapons such as the Phantom Blade, a Hidden Blade with crossbow capabilities.
        
  EXPERIENCE SEAMLESS PARKOUR, COMBAT, AND STEALTH GAMEPLAY  
Enjoy a high degree of freedom and control over your Assassin, with parkour mechanics for seamless free running, a revamped fighting system, and enhanced stealth gameplay.
        
  DISCOVER REVOLUTIONARY PARIS  
The French Revolution turns a once magnificent city into a place of terror and chaos. Explore the stunning, full-scale open world city and witness history unfold. Experience key events, from the storming of the Bastille to the execution of King Louis XVI, as France's fate is shaped in the streets of a city on the edge of transformation.

Experience key events, from the storming of the Bastille to the execution of King Louis XVI, as France's fate is shaped in the streets of a city on the edge of transformation.

UN HÉROE DESPIADADO PARA UN MUNDO BRUTAL  
Ponte en la piel de Arno, una nueva clase de asesino mucho más letal que sus antepasados. Elimina a tu presa con una variedad de armas nuevas, como la Hoja fantasma, una hoja oculta que puede usarse como ballesta.
        
  DISFRUTA DE MECÁNICAS DE PARKOUR, COMBATE Y SIGILO FLUIDAS  
Controla con total libertad a tu asesino con una mecánica de parkour que permite correr libremente con fluidez, un sistema de combate renovado y una mecánica de sigilo mejorada.
        
  DESCUBRE EL PARÍS REVOLUCIONARIO  
La Revolución Francesa ha convertido una ciudad, antaño majestuosa, en un lugar de terror y caos. Explora esta fabulosa ciudad de mundo abierto a escala real y sé testigo de cómo se desarrolla la historia. Vive momentos históricos clave, desde la toma de la Bastilla hasta la ejecución del rey Luis XVI, mientras el destino de Francia se decide en las calles de una ciudad que está experimentando una profunda transformación.

UN NOUVEAU HÉROS SANS PITIÉ POUR UN MONDE SANS MERCI  
Incarnez Arno, un nouveau genre d'Assassins, plus mortel que ses prédécesseurs. Terrassez vos proies avec un arsenal d'armes inédites comme la Lame fantôme, une lame secrète avec une arbalète intégrée.
        
  UN GAMEPLAY FLUIDE MÊLANT PARKOUR, COMBAT ET INFILTRATION  
Profitez d'une grande liberté et d'un contrôle total sur votre Assassin, avec des mécaniques de parkour fluides, un système de combat repensé et un gameplay de furtivité amélioré.
        
  DÉCOUVREZ LE PARIS RÉVOLUTIONNAIRE  
La Révolution française transforme une ville autrefois magnifique en un lieu de terreur et de chaos. Explorez une ville en monde ouvert à échelle 1:1 et regardez l'Histoire se dérouler sous vos yeux. Revivez les événements clés, de la prise de la Bastille à l'exécution du roi Louis XVI, alors que le destin de la France se joue dans les rues d'une ville en pleine transformation.

EIN SKRUPELLOSER NEUER HELD FÜR EINE BRUTALE NEUE WELT  
Spiele als Arno, ein völlig neuer Assassine, der noch tödlicher als seine Vorfahren ist. Erlege deine Beute mit einer Auswahl neuer Waffen wie der Phantomklinge, einer Versteckten Klinge mit eingebauter Armbrust.
        
  ERLEBE NAHTLOSES GAMEPLAY MIT PARKOUR, KAMPF UND SCHLEICHEN  
Genieße ein hohes Maß an Freiheit und Kontrolle über deinen Assassinen, mit Parkour-Mechaniken für nahtloses Free-Running, einem überarbeiteten Kampfsystem und verbessertem Schleichen.
        
  ENTDECKE PARIS WÄHREND DER REVOLUTION  
Die Französische Revolution verwandelt eine einst prachtvolle Stadt in einen Ort des Terrors und der Zerstörung. Erkunde die atemberaubende, originalgetreue Open-World-Stadt und erlebe, wie Geschichte geschrieben wird. Erlebe wichtige historische Ereignisse, vom Sturm auf die Bastille bis zur Hinrichtung von König Ludwig XVI., während das Schicksal Frankreichs auf den Straßen einer sich verwandelnden Stadt seinen Lauf nimmt.

UM NOVO HERÓI IMPLACÁVEL PARA UM NOVO MUNDO BRUTAL  
Jogue como Arno, um tipo de assassino totalmente novo, mais letal que seus antecessores. Cace suas presas com uma gama de novas armas, tais como a Lâmina Fantasma, uma Lâmina Oculta com a capacidade de disparar como uma besta.
        
  EXPERIMENTE A JOGABILIDADE FLUIDA EM PARKOUR, COMBATE E FURTIVIDADE  
Desfrute de um alto grau de liberdade e controle sobre seu assassino, com mecânicas de parkour que possibilitam movimentos livres e fluídos, um sistema de combate reformulado e jogabilidade de furtividade aprimorada.
        
  DESCUBRA A PARIS REVOLUCIONÁRIA  
A Revolução Francesa transformou uma cidade magnífica em um ambiente de terror e caos. Explore essa cidade impressionante como um mundo aberto em larga escala e testemunhe o desenrolar dos eventos históricos. Viva eventos importantes, desde a tomada da Bastilha à execução do Rei Luís XVI, conforme o destino da França é decidido nas ruas de uma cidade à beira da transformação.

EN NÅDESLØS NY HELT TIL EN BRUTAL NY VERDEN  
Spil som Arno: En helt ny type snigmorder, der er endnu mere dødbringende end hans forgængere. Nedlæg dit bytte med nye våben, som for eksempel dit Phantom Blade, der er en skjult klinge med armbrøstfunktionalitet.
        
  OPLEV FLYDENDE PARKOUR, KAMP OG SNIGEGAMEPLAY  
Oplev stor frihed og kontrol over din snigmorder med parkourmekanik, der lader dig løbe helt frit og flydende rundt, et nyt kampsystem og forbedret snigegameplay.
        
  UDFORSK REVOLUTIONENS PARIS  
Den franske revolution omdanner en engang så storslået by til et sted fyldt med rædsel og kaos. Udforsk den utroligt flotte åbne by, og se historien udfolde sig. Oplev vigtige historiske begivenheder, lige fra angrebet på Bastillen til henrettelsen af kong Louis den 16., mens Frankrigs skæbne afgøres i gaderne i en by, der er på randen af den totale transformation.

UN NUOVO EROE SPIETATO PER UN NUOVO MONDO BRUTALE  
Gioca nei panni di Arno, un Assassino totalmente diverso e molto più letale di chiunque l'abbia preceduto. Colpisci i tuoi nemici usando armi inedite come la lama fantasma, un incrocio fra lama celata e balestra.
        
  LA PERFETTA INTEGRAZIONE TRA CORSA ACROBATICA, COMBATTIMENTO E FURTIVITÀ  
Sfrutta al massimo la libertà di movimento e controllo del tuo Assassino, con meccaniche di corsa acrobatica senza soluzione di continuità, un sistema di combattimento rinnovato e sequenze furtive migliorate.
        
  SCOPRI LA PARIGI RIVOLUZIONARIA  
La Rivoluzione francese ha gettato nel terrore e nel caos quella che era una magnifica città. Esplora una magnifica città a mondo aperto, fedele in ogni dettaglio, e vivi la storia in prima persona. Assisti a momenti chiave, come la presa della Bastiglia e l'esecuzione di re Luigi XVI, mentre il futuro della Francia si decide sulle strade di una città sull'orlo del cambiamento.

game.title: Outer Wilds
game.description:
Winner of Best Game at the 2020 BAFTA Games Awards and named Game of the Year 2019 by Giant Bomb, Polygon, Eurogamer, and The Guardian,  Outer Wilds  is a critically-acclaimed and award-winning open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop.
 
   Welcome to the Space Program! 
 You're the newest recruit of Outer Wilds Ventures, a fledgling space program searching for answers in a strange, constantly evolving solar system.  
  
  Mysteries of the Solar System... 
 What lurks in the heart of the ominous Dark Bramble? Who built the alien ruins on the Moon? Can the endless time loop be stopped? Answers await you in the most dangerous reaches of space.
  
  A World That Changes Over Time 
 The planets of  Outer Wilds  are packed with hidden locations that change with the passage of time. Visit an underground city before it's swallowed by sand, or explore the surface of a planet as it crumbles beneath your feet. Every secret is guarded by hazardous environments and natural catastrophes.
  
  Grab Your Intergalactic Hiking Gear! 
 Strap on your hiking boots, check your oxygen levels, and get ready to venture into space. Use a variety of unique gadgets to probe your surroundings, track down mysterious signals, decipher ancient alien writing, and roast the perfect marshmallow.

欢迎加入太空计划！

不祥的 Dark Bramble 星球中心潜伏着什么？月球上的外星人遗迹是谁建造的？能否停止无尽的时间循环？答案在最危险的太空区域等待着你。

一个随时间改变的世界

game.title: Halo: The Master Chief Collection
game.description:
The series that changed console gaming forever is on PC with six blockbuster games in one epic experience.
 
       • PC Settings/Optimizations  
Halo: The Master Chief Collection is now optimized for PC and looking better than ever at up to 4k UHD and at 60+ FPS.* Other setting options include customizable mouse and keyboard support, ultrawide support, FOV customization, and more.
 
       • Campaign  
Featuring Halo: Reach, Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary, Halo 2: Anniversary, Halo 3, Halo 3: ODST Campaign, and Halo 4, The Master Chief Collection offers players their own exciting journey through the epic saga. Starting with the incredible bravery of Noble Six in Halo: Reach and ending with the rise of a new enemy in Halo 4, the Master Chief’s saga totals 67 campaign missions over six critically-acclaimed titles.
 
       • Multiplayer  
Each of the six games in The Master Chief Collection brings its own multiplayer maps, modes and game types. With more than 120 multiplayer maps and countless ways to play with community-created Forge content the Collection has the most diverse and expansive Halo multiplayer experience to date.

        Forge Halo’s iconic map editor is improved, refreshed and better than ever. Build new maps with expanded functionality, increased budget, new objects and create new ways to play with custom game modes.**
 
 
 *Look to system requirements for guidance on hardware minimum specs to achieve performance metrics.
 
 **Forge mode not available in Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary or Halo 3: ODST.

        Forge Halo’s iconic map editor is improved, refreshed and better than ever. Build new maps with expanded functionality, increased budget, new objects and create new ways to play with custom game modes.**
 
 
 *Look to system requirements for guidance on hardware minimum specs to achieve performance metrics.
 
 **Forge mode not available in Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary or Halo 3: ODST.

La saga que cambió para siempre la industria de los videojuegos llega a PC con seis auténticas obras maestras con las que vivirás una experiencia épica.
 
 Ajustes del PC/Optimización: Halo: la colección Jefe Maestro ha sido optimizada para PC y luce mejor que nunca, con modos hasta 4K UHD a más de 60 FPS.* Otras opciones de configuración incluyen configuración personalizada de ratón y teclado compatibilidad con pantalla ultrapanorámica, campo de visión personalizable y mucho más.
 
 Campaña: la colección Jefe Maestro incluye Halo: Reach, Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary, Halo 2: Anniversary, Halo 3, Halo 3: ODST Campaign y Halo 4, por lo que los jugadores podrán disfrutar de un viaje trepidante y exclusivo por toda la épica saga. La saga del Jefe Maestro suma 67 misiones de campaña en seis títulos aclamados por la crítica, desde la increíble valentía de Noble seis en Halo: Reach hasta la aparición de un nuevo enemigo en Halo 4.
 
 Multijugador: cada uno de los seis juegos de la colección Jefe Maestro incluye sus propios mapas, modos y tipos de juego multijugador. Con más de 120 mapas multijugador e infinitas formas de disfrutar del contenido de Forge creado por la comunidad, la colección ofrece la experiencia multijugador más variada y amplia de Halo hasta la fecha.

 El emblemático editor de mapas de Halo incorpora mejoras y actualizaciones y tiene mejor aspecto que nunca. Crea nuevos mapas con mayor funcionalidad, más presupuesto y nuevos objetos, e idea nuevas formas de jugar con los modos de juego personalizados.**
 

 *Consulta los requisitos del sistema para saber qué especificaciones mínimas de hardware se necesitan para conseguir un rendimiento óptimo.
 
 **El modo Forge no está disponible en Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ni en Halo 3: ODST.

La saga qui a révolutionné les jeux sur console débarque sur PC avec 6 titres incontournables réunis au sein d'une expérience épique.

 Paramètres/optimisations PC : Halo : La collection le Major est maintenant optimisé pour PC et affiche des graphismes somptueux jusqu'en 4K UHD à au moins 60 images/seconde.* Profitez également des commandes personnalisables à la souris et au clavier, de l'affichage ultra large, du champ de vision réglable et bien plus encore.
  
 Campagne : avec Halo: Reach, Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary, Halo 2: Anniversary, Halo 3, la campagne Halo 3: ODST et Halo 4, La collection le Major vous invite à tracer votre propre voie à travers la saga Halo. Démarrant avec la bravoure exceptionnelle de Noble Six dans Halo: Reach et culminant avec l'émergence d'un nouvel ennemi dans Halo 4, la saga du Major totalise 67 missions de campagne réparties sur 6 titres salués par la critique.
 
 Multijoueur : chaque titre intégré à la collection comprend également des cartes, modes et types de parties qui lui sont propres. Avec plus de 120 cartes multijoueur, et le riche contenu Forge créé par la communauté permettant des parties sans cesse renouvelées, La collection le Major offre l'expérience Halo la plus variée et la plus étendue jamais proposée.

 Forge : le célèbre éditeur de cartes de Halo revient plus phénoménal que jamais. Créez de nouvelles cartes grâce à des fonctionnalités novatrices, un plus gros budget et des objets inédits, afin de proposer de nouvelles façons de jouer avec des modes de jeu personnalisés.**

 
 * Consultez la configuration requise pour en savoir plus sur le matériel qui vous permettra d'atteindre des performances adaptées.
 
 ** Le mode Forge n'est pas disponible dans Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary et Halo 3: ODST.

Die Serie, die das Spielen auf Konsole für immer revolutioniert hat, gibt es nun auch als episches Paket mit sechs Einzeltiteln für den PC.
 
 PC-Einstellungen/Optimierung: Halo: The Master Chief Collection wurde für den PC optimiert und sieht jetzt mit bis zu 4K UHD und 60+ FPS besser aus denn je.* Weitere Einstellungen schließen anpassbare Unterstützung für Maus und Tastatur, Ultrawide-Anzeige, FOV-Anpassung und mehr ein.

 Kampagne: Mit Halo: Reach, Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary, Halo 2: Anniversary, Halo 3, Halo 3: ODST Campaign und Halo 4 bietet The Master Chief Collection Spielern eine aufregende Reise durch die epische Saga. Beginnend mit den wagemutigen Noblen Sechs in Halo: Reach und abschließend mit dem Aufstieg eines neuen Feindes in Halo 4 erscheinen die Spiele in der chronologischen Reihenfolge der Geschichte. Nach dem Abschluss der Veröffentlichung wird die Master-Chief-Sage 67 Kampagnenmissionen enthalten.

 Multiplayer: Jedes der 6 Spiele aus The Master Chief Collection hat eigene Multiplayer-Karten, Spielmodi und -typen. Mit über 120 Multiplayer-Karten und unzählige Möglichkeiten, die von der Community erstellten Schmiede-Inhalten zu spielen bietet die Collection das vielfältigste und größte Multiplayer-Erlebnis überhaupt.

 Schmiede: Halos kultiger Karteneditor wurde verbessert und überholt und ist nun so gut wie nie zuvor. Erstellen Sie neue Karten mit erweiterten Funktionen, höherem Budget und neuen Gegenständen und erfinden Sie neue Spielmöglichkeiten mit den anpassbaren Spielmodi.**

 
 *Hinweise zu Systemanforderungen entnehmen Sie bitte den Mindestanforderungen.
 
 **Der Schmiedemodus ist für Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary und Halo 3: ODST nicht verfügbar.

La serie che ha cambiato per sempre il gioco su console ora è disponibile su PC con sei titoli di successo riuniti in un'esperienza epica.

 Impostazioni/Ottimizzazioni PC Halo: The Master Chief Collection ora è ottimizzata per girare su PC fino a 4K UHD a 60+ FPS*. Altre impostazioni native per PC comprendono l'uso di mouse e tastiera, il supporto per monitor ultrawide, la personalizzazione del campo visivo e tanto altro ancora.

 Campagna: con Halo: Reach, Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary, Halo 2: Anniversary, Halo 3, Halo 3: ODST Campaign e Halo 4, Halo: The Master Chief Collection offre ai giocatori un emozionante viaggio attraverso l’epica saga. Iniziando con l’incredibile coraggio della squadra Noble Six in Halo: Reach e culminando con l’ascesa di un nuovo nemico in Halo 4. La Master Chief Collection raccoglie 67 missioni campagna di ben 6 giochi amati dalla critica.

 Multiplayer: Ognuno dei 6 giochi che compone la Master Chief Collection porta con sé le proprie mappe, modalità e tipi di gioco multiplayer. Con più di 120 mappe multiplayer e moltissime modalità per giocare ai contenuti creati dalla community nella Fucina, questa raccolta contiene l'esperienza multiplayer più ampia e diversificata dell'intero universo di Halo.
 
 Fucina: L'iconico creatore di mappe per Halo è stato migliorato, ottimizzato ed ora è migliore che mai. Costruisci nuove mappe con funzionalità ampliate, budget maggiore, nuovi oggetti e nuovi modi di creare modalità di gioco personalizzate.**

 
 *Controlla i requisiti di sistema e dell'hardware per sfruttare al meglio queste funzionalità.
 
 **La modalità Fucina non è disponibile su Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary né su Halo 3: ODST.

主人公成天关在家里，在18x产品上花了大把时间。她要是哪天没有被传送到视觉小说游戏里，那她就要无聊死了！
当然，对这位小姑娘来说，眼下这种情况可不是什么好事。你不仅能窥视她所有羞耻的念头，还要陪她玩，给她解闷。你跑来看这个故事，不就是为了这个吗？
她现在好像得出去一趟了，起码要去采购点日用品……可是她走到哪里，故事情节就跟到哪里！
游戏卖点：
- 游戏里有两个女孩子，一个叫病娇酱，一个叫默娇酱。她们的恋爱线路都是完全原创的，绝对不会让你觉得俗套；
- 重要的游戏选项200+，每个都跟主角有关；
- 3个不同的结局（这3个结局你也不用全看，不会影响你理解整体剧情！）；
- 卖点这一栏说的都是千真万确，没有半点假话，也没想要让拉高你的期望再把它给掐掉什么的；
- 好吧，这就是个百合后宫福利向的游戏，没那么多弯弯绕绕，点开直接就是百合贴贴
技术卖点：
× 画面分辨率高达640x480！
× 《梦日记》风格的配乐，很洗脑很容易上瘾，一段旋律10秒之内循环一次！
× 出场角色的胸部都很大

这是视觉小说游戏《REFLEXIA》的原型版，晚些时候应该会有重制版。

game.title: FTL: Faster Than Light
game.description:
FTL is now available in 9 languages!  English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Mandarin!
 
 ************************
 The free expansion, FTL: Advanced Edition, is available now!  Content additions include: new alien race, events, weapons, playable ships, drones, and more!  Also adds additional musical tracks by Ben Prunty, and events by Tom Jubert and guest writer Chris Avellone. 
 
 If you already own FTL it should update the new content automatically.  Advanced Edition is included free for anyone who purchases the game from this point forward.
 ************************
 
 In FTL you experience the atmosphere of running a spaceship trying to save the galaxy. It's a dangerous mission, with every encounter presenting a unique challenge with multiple solutions. What will you do if a heavy missile barrage shuts down your shields? Reroute all power to the engines in an attempt to escape, power up additional weapons to blow your enemy out of the sky, or take the fight to them with a boarding party? This "spaceship simulation roguelike-like" allows you to take your ship and crew on an adventure through a randomly generated galaxy filled with glory and bitter defeat. Key Features:    Complex Strategic Gameplay  - Give orders to your crew, manage ship power distribution and choose weapon targets in the heat of battle.
    Play at Your Own Speed  - Pause the game mid-combat to evaluate your strategy and give orders.
    Unique Lifeforms and Technology  – Upgrade your ship and unlock new ones with the help of six diverse alien races.
    Be the Captain You Want  - Hundreds of text based encounters will force you to make tough decisions.
    Randomized Galaxy  - Each play-through will feature different enemies, events, and results to your decisions. No two play-throughs will be quite the same.
    No Second Chances!  - Permadeath means when you die, there's no coming back. The constant threat of defeat adds importance and tension to every action.
