你可以通过如下操作将游戏语言设置为简体中文：点击游戏菜单中的“Settings”选项，在设置窗口中将右下角的“Language”从“English”改为“Chinese (Simplified)”，然后重新启动游戏。
  
 我们将卡牌游戏与Roguelike游戏融为一体，制作出了这款最棒的单机组牌游戏。打造出独一无二的牌组、遇见无数离奇的生物、发现威力强大的遗物、去屠戮这座高塔吧！
 
    游戏特色     动态构建的牌组 ：谨慎选择你的卡牌！在攀爬高塔的途中邂逅百余张不同的卡牌，选择是否将它们加入你的牌组，通过组合和搭配来让牌组发挥力量，打败敌人、挑战登顶。
    不断变化的高塔 ：每次开始爬塔的旅程时，高塔的构造都会发生变化。是选择高风险高回报，还是谨慎前行？面对不同的敌人、选择不同的卡牌、发现不同的遗物、甚至挑战不同的Boss！
    威力强大的遗物 ：在塔中你将发现名为遗物的各种强大物品，这些遗物可能会与你的牌组产生强大的化学反应，让你的战力得到飞跃。但也不要过于大意，为了获得遗物，有时你所付出的代价，可会超过区区金钱……  
    《Slay the Spire》已经结束抢先体验，目前游戏共有下述内容：    四名角色，各自拥有独特的牌组。
   350多张可用的卡牌。
   200多种可被找到的物品与道具。
   50多场完全不同的战斗。
   50多件神秘的事件，可能给你带来帮助，也可能将你害得很惨。
   每日挑战模式，让你可以在进行独特游戏的同时，与世界各地的玩家们比较你的表现。
   自定模式，让你可以自由混合各种疯狂的特殊效果。

我們將卡牌遊戲與 Roguelike 遊戲融為一體，製作出了這款最棒的單機牌組構築遊戲。打造出獨一無二的牌組、遇見無數離奇的生物、發現威力強大的遺物、去屠戮這座高塔吧！
 
    遊戲特色     動態構建的牌組 ：謹慎選擇你的卡牌！在攀爬高塔的途中邂逅百餘張不同的卡牌，選擇是否將它們加入你的牌組，透過組合和搭配來讓牌組發揮力量，打敗敵人、挑戰登頂。
    不斷變化的高塔 ：每次開始爬塔的旅程時，高塔的構造都會發生變化。是選擇高風險高回報，還是謹慎前行？面對不同的敵人、選擇不同的卡牌、發現不同的遺物、甚至挑戰不同的首領！
    威力強大的遺物 ：在塔中你將發現名為遺物的各種強大物品，這些遺物可能會與你的牌組產生強大的化學反應，讓你的戰力得到飛躍。但也不要過於大意，為了獲得遺物，有時你所付出的代價，可會超過區區金錢……  
    《Slay the Spire》已經結束搶先體驗，目前遊戲共有下述內容：    四名角色，各自擁有獨特的牌組。
   350 多張可用的卡牌。
   200 多種可被找到的物品與道具。
   50 多場完全不同的戰鬥遭遇。
   50 多件神秘的事件，可能給你帶來幫助，也可能將你害得很慘。
   每日挑戰模式，讓你可以在進行獨特遊戲的同時，與世界各地的玩家們比較你的表現。
   自訂模式，讓你可以自由混合各種瘋狂的特殊效果。

Hemos fusionado juegos de cartas y roguelikes para crear el mejor juego de cartas para un solo jugador que pudiéramos. Crea un mazo único, encuentra criaturas extrañas, descubre reliquias de inmenso poder y mata La Aguja.
 
    Características    

• Construcción dinámica de mazos: Elige tus cartas sabiamente! Descubre cientos de cartas para añadir a tu baraja con cada intento de escalar la Aguja. Selecciona cartas que funcionen juntas para despachar eficazmente a los enemigos y llegar a la cima. 
    
• Una Aguja siempre cambiante: Cada vez que te embarcas en un viaje por la Aguja, el diseño difiere de las anteriores. Elige un camino arriesgado o seguro, enfréntate a enemigos diferentes, elige cartas diferentes, descubre reliquias diferentes e incluso lucha contra jefes diferentes.
    
• Reliquias poderosas a descubrir: Poderosos objetos conocidos como reliquias se pueden encontrar en toda la Aguja. Los efectos de estas reliquias pueden mejorar mucho tu baraja a través de poderosas interacciones. Pero ten cuidado, obtener una reliquia puede costarte más que sólo oro....  
    
Slay the Spire viene con:    

• Cuatro personajes principales, cada con su propio set de cartas.
   • Más de 350 cartas totalmente implementadas.
   • Más de 200 objetos diferentes a encontrar.
   • Más de 50 encuentros de combate únicos.
   • Más de 50 eventos misteriosos que pueden ayudarte o dañarte.
   • Las Partidas Diarias te permiten compararte con todos los demás jugadores del mundo.
   • El Modo Personalizado te permite mezclar y hacer coincidir varios modificadores de partidas locas.

En fusionnant les jeux de cartes avec les roguelikes, nous sommes arrivés à créer le jeu de cartes solo le plus intéressant possible. Construisez votre deck, rencontrez toutes sortes d'ennemis bizarres, découvrez des reliques aux pouvoirs immenses, et éradiquez la tour!
 
    Caractéristiques     

• Construisez votre deck : Choisissez bien vos cartes! Combinez les effets des cartes pour éliminer les ennemis et survivre jusqu'en haut de la tour.

Slay the Spire contient :    

• Quatre personnages ayant chacun leur propre set de cartes dédié.
   • 350+ cartes entièrement fonctionnelles.
   • 200+ objets et reliques à découvrir.
   • 50+ combats uniques.
   • 50+ évènements mystérieux qui peuvent vous aider ou vous nuire.
   • Des défis quotidiens pour vous mesurer aux autres joueurs dans le monde.
   • Un mode personnalisé qui permet de sélectionner différents modificateurs délirants.

    Features     

• Dynamischer Deckbau: Wähle deine Karten weise! Entdecke bei jedem Versuch, den Spire zu besteigen, hunderte von Karten, die du deinem Deck hinzufügen kannst. Suche dir Karten aus, die effizient zusammenarbeiten, um deine Feinde zu überwinden und die Spitze zu erreichen.
    
• Ein sich ständig ändernder Spire: Auf jeder Reise in den Spire ändert sich die Anordnung der Räume. Wähle einen riskanten oder sicheren Weg, stelle dich anderen Feinden, wähle andere Karten, entdecke andere Relikte und kämpfe sogar gegen andere Bosse!

• vier Hauptcharaktere mit jeweils komplett individuellen Kartensatz,
   • 350+ vollständig implementierte Karten,
   • 200+ verschiedene Gegenstände, die gefunden werden können,
   • 50+ unterschiedliche Kampfbegegnungen,
   • 50+ geheimnisvolle Ereignisse, die dir helfen oder schaden können,
   • Den Run des Tages, bei dem du dich mit den Spielern auf der ganzen Welt messen kannst.
   • Einen Spezialmodus, in dem du deine eigene Kombination aus verrückten Sonderregeln auswählst.

game.title: Blacktail
game.description:
Become the witch of the woods in Blacktail. Slavic myth comes to life in this first-person open world action adventure. Discover Yaga’s story and guide her along the path to become a fearsome guardian of the forest or the dark legend that haunts children’s nightmares.

You are Yaga, a 16-year-old girl accused of witchcraft and expelled from an early medieval Slavic settlement. When living memories of her past return as foul spirits walking the earth, Yaga’s best choice is to do what she does best: hunt them down.

Create the myth of Baba Yaga by living out the origins of this classic Slavic folk story in Blacktail, the first-person action-adventure from The Parasite. Experience a one-of-a-kind blend of intense archery combat and dark storytelling. Choose your path to become the guardian of the woods or the terror nightmares are based on.

game.title: 1000xRESIST
game.description:
Buzz   "1000xRESIST nails what it's going for—a blend of "big idea" sci-fi and coming-of-age story." 
 -  PC Gamer 
 
  "At its heights, it achieves the cerebral complexity I expect from the likes of Hideo Kojima or Yoko Taro..." 
 -  PC GamesN 
 
  "It’s a lucid dream, hand crafted for you. It’s extraordinary. It’s something really very special. In a world plagued by extruded content emanating vacuously from every screen, we should be so lucky." 
 -  Giant Bomb 
 
  STAY INFORMED        
 Sign up to our Fellow Traveller community to hear more about 1000xRESIST, and exclusive announcements, behind the scenes sneak peaks, competitions and more from all our story-rich games!
 
  About the Game  
 The three time IGF award nominated 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. 1000 years in the future, humanity is all but extinguished and a disease spread by an alien occupation keeps the survivors underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in service of the ALLMOTHER, until the day you learn a shocking secret that changes everything.
 
  
  
 
 In the near future we learn we are not alone in the universe. A mysterious alien race of giant entities arrives. We call them the Occupants.
 
 They are not hostile, but it doesn’t matter. Their arrival is a death sentence. Humanity is wiped out in a matter of months, succumbing to a disease the Occupants have brought to our planet.
 
 There is one survivor, a teenage girl called Iris. Somehow she is immune. 
 
  
  
 
 1000 years later. Iris is not only immune but immortal. She has birthed a new society consisting exclusively of her own clones. 
 
 She calls them Sisters. They call her the ALLMOTHER.
 
 Unlike the ALLMOTHER, the sisters are not immune. They must wear masks 24/7 to avoid breathing the diseased air even in the Orchard - an underground bunker where they live in constant fear of an Occupant attack.
 
 The ALLMOTHER lives in her own compound on the front line of the war with the Occupants. All Sisters dream of one day being able to take the train and join her in the fight.
 
  
 Within the Orchard, every sister has an assigned function, while six sisters have special roles to play…
 
  
 
   Principal - Head of administration and oversight of the Orchard
   Bang Bang Fire - Head of military
   Knower - Head of knowledge preservation
   Fixer - Head of engineering
   Healer - Head of medical and cloning  
 And you - the new  Watcher .
 
 Your role is unique. You have the great privilege of reliving and interpreting the memories of the ALLMOTHER through a process known as Communion, made possible by Secretary, your floating AI companion.
 
  
 
 As the game begins, you are excited to embark on your first Communion.
 
  
 But all is not well.
 
 Your closest sister, Fixer, comes to you with a dangerous revelation. You have been lied to. The ALLMOTHER is not what she claims to be.
 
 Fixer’s claims rock the foundations of your world, throwing everything you know and believe into doubt.
 
 After Fixer is executed for her treason, it falls to you to discover the truth.
 
  
 
  
 Dive into the memories of the ALLMOTHER.
 
 Explore pivotal moments in her life from high school days and the arrival of the Occupants to the creation of the Orchard and the birth of the first sisters.
 
 Jump back and forth through moments in time within these memories to solve puzzles and access locked off areas and secrets.
 
  
 
 In between Communions, explore the Orchard - a large underground hub area which houses you and your sisters, has many characters to speak to, and holds many things to uncover.
 
 Find the truth and reclaim your legacy.
 
  
 Experience perspective shifts both literal and metaphorical as the game blends between 3rd person adventure, visual novel and first person walking simulator while throwing twists, turns and revelations at you until you question everything you think you know.
 
  
 
 Born from an eclectic set of inspirations, including the games of Yoko Taro (NieR:Automata), the anime of Satoshi Kon (Perfect Blue) and Naoko Yamada (A Silent Voice), and even the theatre of Robert Wilson (Einstein on the Beach), 1000xRESIST tells a story in ways only a game can while simultaneously bringing fresh ideas to interactive storytelling from theatre, dance, performance art, and cinema.
 
  
 Enjoy more than 10 hours of playtime brought to life with over 15,000 lines of fully voiced dialogue from a brilliant cast of Asian-Canadian actors and an incredible soundtrack from two composers.
 
  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675830/1000xRESIST/  ABOUT THE DEVELOPER 
  
 
 1000xRESIST is created by sunset visitor 斜陽過客, an independent studio based in Vancouver (Canada) dedicated to telling diverse stories through the lens of speculative fiction. We are a group of majority Asian-Canadian diaspora creators with a decade of experience in dance, theatre, music, film, visual arts, and new media arts, bringing our background in the experimental performing arts to interactive media.

  隨時掌握最新動態        
 訂閲 Fellow Traveller 敘事遊戲社群，追蹤《1000xRESIST》的最新動態，此外還有其他劇情豐富遊戲的獨家公告、幕後搶先看、對戰賽事乃至更多資訊喔！
 
  關於此遊戲  
 《1000xRESIST》是一款驚心動魄的科幻冒險遊戲。千年後的未來，人類滅絕殆盡，而異星種群佔領所帶來的某種疾病，又令幸存者不得不逃入地底。妳是觀靈。妳盡職盡責履行侍奉「全人之母」的使命，直到有一天，妳得知一個驚天祕密，一切就此改寫。
 
  
  
 
 在不遠的將來，我們得知在茫茫宇宙中，人類並不孤單。來自異星的神祕巨型生靈，悄然降臨地球。我們將祂們稱為「佔領者」。
 
 祂們並無敵意，但這不重要。祂們的到來，就已是為人類宣判死刑。區區數月之內，人類不敵緊隨佔領者而至的某種疾病，整個種族灰飛煙滅。
 
 就在此時，地球上出現一位救世主——名為伊麗絲的少女。不知何故，她對這種疾病免疫。 
 
  
  
 
 千年之後，伊麗絲不僅免於疾患，還免於死亡，獲得永生。她孕育出全新的人類社會，完全由她本人的複製人構成。
 
 她喚她們作「姊妹」，她們則稱她為「全人之母」。
 
 和全人之母不同，姊妹們並不免疫。她們必須全天候戴上口罩，才能避免吸入致病的空氣，即使是在地堡「果園」也不例外。對於佔領者發動攻擊的恐懼如影隨形，她們終日躲在地下避難。
 
 全人之母住在自己的營地，堅守在與佔領者對峙的戰爭前線。所有姊妹都夢想有朝一日接受訓練，與她並肩作戰。
 
  
 在果園之內，每位姊妹都分配有各自的職能，其中有六位姊妹，更是扮演著特殊的角色……
 
  
 
   長姊 - 行政主管兼果園監察人
   火爆 - 軍事主管
   賢知 - 知識保藏主管
   阿修 - 工程主管
   癒醫 - 醫療與複製主管  
 還有妳——新任 觀靈 。
 
 妳的職責獨一無二。懸浮 AI 同伴「祕書」將協助妳進行「靈交」，妳擁有重歷和解讀「全人之母」記憶的無上特權。
 
  
 
 遊戲開始時，妳正為即將踏上首次「靈交」的旅程而興奮不已。
 
  
 然而一切並不如意。
 
 妳最親密的姊妹阿修，對妳透露了一則危險的內幕消息。原來，妳們都被騙了。真正的全人之母，與她口中的自己完全兩樣。
 
 阿修的說法撼動了妳的全世界，將妳所知所信的一切頓時化作疑竇。
 
 在阿修因謀反而遭到處決後，發掘真相的重任就落到了妳肩上。
 
  
 
  
 躍入全人之母的記憶深處。
 
 探索她生命中的關鍵時刻：從中學歲月及「佔領者」的降臨，到「果園」的創造和首批姊妹的誕生。
 
 在記憶長河的大小片段之間來回跳躍，撥開重重迷霧，窺探那些上鎖區域和祕密。
 
  
 
 在「靈交」間隙，探索「果園」這片龐大的地下樞紐區域。這裡容納著你和所有姊妹，有眾多可交談的角色，還有大量故事等待挖掘。
 
 尋找真相，重拾遺落往昔的力量。
 
  
 遊戲將第三人稱冒險、視覺小說和第一人稱步行模擬三種類型融會貫通，體驗畫面上和心境上的視角轉換；此外還會抛出各種劇情轉折和驚天真相，直至妳開始質疑此前所知道的一切。
 
  
 
 本遊戲從諸多風格迥異的作品汲取靈感，包括橫尾太郎的遊戲（《尼爾：自動人形》）、今敏的動畫（《藍色恐懼》）和山田尚子的動畫（《聲之形》），乃至羅伯·威爾森的戲劇作品（《海灘上的愛因斯坦》）。《1000xRESIST》採用遊戲特有的表現方式來講述故事，同時又從戲劇、舞蹈、表現藝術和電影博采眾長，為互動敘事帶來嶄新的創意。
 
  
 一群亞裔加拿大配音演員傾情演繹超過15,000句對話台詞，再佐以兩位作曲家的精彩配樂，令玩家在十餘小時的遊戲過程中身臨其境。
 
  
 
  
 
  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675830/1000xRESIST/  關於開發團隊 
  
 
 《1000xRESIST》由 sunset visitor 斜陽過客創作，這是一家位於加拿大溫哥華的獨立工作室，致力於透過推想小說的鏡頭講述多元故事。我們是一群主要由亞裔加拿大人組成的創作者，在舞蹈、戲劇、音樂、電影、視覺藝術和新媒體藝術方面有十餘年經驗，力圖將我們在實驗表演藝術方面的背景呈現在互動媒體上。

  Acerca del juego  
 The three time IGF award nominated 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. 1000 years in the future, humanity is all but extinguished and a disease spread by an alien occupation keeps the survivors underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in service of the ALLMOTHER, until the day you learn a shocking secret that changes everything.
 
  
  
 
 In the near future we learn we are not alone in the universe. A mysterious alien race of giant entities arrives. We call them the Occupants.
 
 They are not hostile, but it doesn’t matter. Their arrival is a death sentence. Humanity is wiped out in a matter of months, succumbing to a disease the Occupants have brought to our planet.
 
 There is one survivor, a teenage girl called Iris. Somehow she is immune. 
 
  
  
 
 1000 years later. Iris is not only immune but immortal. She has birthed a new society consisting exclusively of her own clones. 
 
 She calls them Sisters. They call her the ALLMOTHER.
 
 Unlike the ALLMOTHER, the sisters are not immune. They must wear masks 24/7 to avoid breathing the diseased air even in the Orchard - an underground bunker where they live in constant fear of an Occupant attack.
 
 The ALLMOTHER lives in her own compound on the front line of the war with the Occupants. All Sisters dream of one day being able to take the train and join her in the fight.
 
  
 Within the Orchard, every sister has an assigned function, while six sisters have special roles to play…
 
  
 
   Principal - Head of administration and oversight of the Orchard
   Bang Bang Fire - Head of military
   Knower - Head of knowledge preservation
   Fixer - Head of engineering
   Healer - Head of medical and cloning  
 And you - the new  Watcher .
 
 Your role is unique. You have the great privilege of reliving and interpreting the memories of the ALLMOTHER through a process known as Communion, made possible by Secretary, your floating AI companion.
 
  
 
 As the game begins, you are excited to embark on your first Communion.
 
  
 But all is not well.
 
 Your closest sister, Fixer, comes to you with a dangerous revelation. You have been lied to. The ALLMOTHER is not what she claims to be.
 
 Fixer’s claims rock the foundations of your world, throwing everything you know and believe into doubt.
 
 After Fixer is executed for her treason, it falls to you to discover the truth.
 
  
 
  
 Dive into the memories of the ALLMOTHER.
 
 Explore pivotal moments in her life from high school days and the arrival of the Occupants to the creation of the Orchard and the birth of the first sisters.
 
 Jump back and forth through moments in time within these memories to solve puzzles and access locked off areas and secrets.
 
  
 
 In between Communions, explore the Orchard - a large underground hub area which houses you and your sisters, has many characters to speak to, and holds many things to uncover.
 
 Find the truth and reclaim your legacy.
 
  
 Experience perspective shifts both literal and metaphorical as the game blends between 3rd person adventure, visual novel and first person walking simulator while throwing twists, turns and revelations at you until you question everything you think you know.
 
  
 
 Born from an eclectic set of inspirations, including the games of Yoko Taro (NieR:Automata), the anime of Satoshi Kon (Perfect Blue) and Naoko Yamada (A Silent Voice), and even the theatre of Robert Wilson (Einstein on the Beach), 1000xRESIST tells a story in ways only a game can while simultaneously bringing fresh ideas to interactive storytelling from theatre, dance, performance art, and cinema.
 
  
 Enjoy more than 10 hours of playtime brought to life with over 15,000 lines of fully voiced dialogue from a brilliant cast of Asian-Canadian actors and an incredible soundtrack from two composers.

We are a group of majority Asian-Canadian diaspora creators with a decade of experience in dance, theatre, music, film, visual arts, and new media arts, bringing our background in the experimental performing arts to interactive media.

  最新情報はこちらから        
 Fellow Travellerの物語あふれるコミュニティーに参加して、1000xRESISTの情報をさらに手に入れよう。プレイヤーの感情を揺さぶるゲームの数々に関する、ここだけのお知らせや最新情報のプレビュー、コンテストが待っています！
 
  ゲームについて  
 
  
 
 1000xRESISTでスリリングなSFアドベンチャーを体験しよう。これは1000年後の未来――人類のほとんどが死滅し、生き残った者たちも異星の侵略者によってばらまかれた疫病の影響で、地下に身を潜める世界。ウォッチャーとなって「全能の母」に仕え、任務をまっとうせよ。すべての根底を覆す、衝撃的な秘密を知ってしまうその日まで。
 
  
  
 
 さほど遠くない未来で、我らは知る。この宇宙に生きるのは、我らのみではない、と。突如現れた、謎の巨大な異星種族。我らはそれを「占有者(the Occupants)」と呼んだ。
 
 敵意はなかったが、問題はそこではない。彼らの到来は死を意味した。占有者がこの星にまき散らした疫病によって、ほんの数ヶ月のあいだに人類はほぼ死滅したのだ。
 
 唯一生き残ったのは、10代の少女アイリス。理由は定かではないものの、その少女は免疫を持っていた。
 
  
  
 
 1000年後。免疫を持つだけではなく、不死でもあったアイリスは、自分のクローンのみで新たな社会を構築した。
 
 クローンらは「姉妹たち(Sisters)」と呼ばれ、アイリスは「全能の母(ALLMOTHER)」と呼ばれた。
 
 だが全能の母と違って、姉妹たちは免疫を持っておらず、汚染された空気を吸いこまないよう常にマスクをつけていなければならなかった。それは占有者の攻撃に絶えず怯えながら暮らす地下シェルター「果樹園(the Orchard)」内でも、例外ではなかった。
 
 全能の母は今も、占有者たちとの戦いの最前線に身を置いている。そしてすべての姉妹たちは、その戦線に加われる日を夢見ている。
 
  
 果樹園では、すべての姉妹たちが使命を持つ。そのうち6人の姉妹たちには、特別な役職が与えられている。
 
  
 
   プリンシパル - 政府のトップであり、果樹園を監視する者
   バン・バン・ファイア - 軍事のトップ
   ノウアー - 知識保全のトップ
   フィクサー - エンジニアリングのトップ
   ヒーラー - 医療分野およびクローン管理のトップ  
 そしてあなた… ウォッチャー だ。
 
 その役目は実に独特で、強大な特権のもと、宙に遊ぶパートナーAIの「セクレタリー(Secretary)」が実行する「コミュニオン(Communion)」と呼ばれるプロセスを通じて、全能の母の記憶を追体験し、解釈するのが任務だ。
 
  
 
 物語が始まれば、初めてのコミュニオンに胸が躍ることだろう。
 
  
 だが、嵐は突然やってくる。
 
 一番親しい姉妹のフィクサーが、恐ろしい話をウォッチャーに告げた。我らはあざむかれていたのだ…全能の母は、彼女自身が語るような存在ではなかったのだ、と。
 
 フィクサーの言葉はあなたの世界を揺るがし、信じるものすべてに疑惑の種を植え付けた。
 
 その後フィクサーは反逆罪の咎で処刑され、真実の解明はウォッチャーに託された。
 
  
 
  
 全能の母の記憶に飛び込もう。
 
 高校時代、占有者の到来と果樹園の創設、そして、最初の姉妹の創造――全能の母の人生の中でも重要な時を探索しよう。
 
 これら記憶の中で時代を行き来し、謎を解け。そうすれば、封じられた領域へとアクセスできるようになる。
 
  
 
 コミュニオンの合間には、ウォッチャーを含む姉妹たちが暮らす広大な地下シェルター「果樹園」を探索し、さまざまな住人に話しかけ、多くの謎を解き明かそう。
 
 真実を見つけ出し、過去の遺産を手に入れろ。
 
  
 3人称視点でのアドベンチャーとノベルゲーム、1人称視点でのウォーキングシミュレーターが融合する世界で、事実と隠喩の視点の移り変わりを体験しよう。ひねり、予期せぬ展開、そして驚くべき新事実を投げかけられ、あなたは把握していたつもりの物事に疑問を抱くようになるだろう。
 
  
 
 ヨコオタロウ氏（『NieR:Automata』）のゲーム作品、今敏氏（『パーフェクトブルー』）と山田尚子氏（『聲の形』）のアニメ作品、そして舞台演出家のロバート・ウィルソン氏（『浜辺のアインシュタイン』）から数々のインスピレーションを経て生み出された1000xRESISTは、ゲームのみが実現可能なストーリーを提供する一方で、舞台、ダンス、パフォーマンスアート、映画の双方向なストーリーテリングに新鮮なひらめきを与えている。
 
  
 15000を超えるセリフを、アジア系カナダ人俳優によるフルボイスで実装。卓越した2名の作曲家によるサウンドと併せて、10時間以上におよぶプレイ体験に酔いしれよう。
 
  
 
  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675830/1000xRESIST/  開発チームについて 
  
 
 1000xRESISTは、カナダのバンクーバーに拠点を置き、純理論的フィクションのレンズを通して描く多様な物語の創出に秀でた独立系のスタジオ、sunset visitor（斜陽過客）が開発しています。メンバーの大多数は元来の国を離れて定着したアジア系カナダ人であり、ダンス、舞台、音楽、映画、ビジュアルアート、ニュー・メディア・アートの分野における長年の経験を活かして、双方向メディアに実験的なパフォーマンス・アートのバックグラウンドを取り入れています。

Buzz   "1000xRESIST nails what it's going for—a blend of "big idea" sci-fi and coming-of-age story." 
 -  PC Gamer 
 
  "At its heights, it achieves the cerebral complexity I expect from the likes of Hideo Kojima or Yoko Taro..." 
 -  PC GamesN 
 
  "It’s a lucid dream, hand crafted for you. It’s extraordinary. It’s something really very special. In a world plagued by extruded content emanating vacuously from every screen, we should be so lucky." 
 -  Giant Bomb 
 
  STAY INFORMED        
 Sign up to our Fellow Traveller community to hear more about 1000xRESIST, and exclusive announcements, behind the scenes sneak peaks, competitions and more from all our story-rich games!
 
  About the Game  
 The three time IGF award nominated 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. 1000 years in the future, humanity is all but extinguished and a disease spread by an alien occupation keeps the survivors underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in service of the ALLMOTHER, until the day you learn a shocking secret that changes everything.
 
  
  
 
 In the near future we learn we are not alone in the universe. A mysterious alien race of giant entities arrives. We call them the Occupants.
 
 They are not hostile, but it doesn’t matter. Their arrival is a death sentence. Humanity is wiped out in a matter of months, succumbing to a disease the Occupants have brought to our planet.
 
 There is one survivor, a teenage girl called Iris. Somehow she is immune. 
 
  
  
 
 1000 years later. Iris is not only immune but immortal. She has birthed a new society consisting exclusively of her own clones. 
 
 She calls them Sisters. They call her the ALLMOTHER.
 
 Unlike the ALLMOTHER, the sisters are not immune. They must wear masks 24/7 to avoid breathing the diseased air even in the Orchard - an underground bunker where they live in constant fear of an Occupant attack.
 
 The ALLMOTHER lives in her own compound on the front line of the war with the Occupants. All Sisters dream of one day being able to take the train and join her in the fight.
 
  
 Within the Orchard, every sister has an assigned function, while six sisters have special roles to play…
 
  
 
   Principal - Head of administration and oversight of the Orchard
   Bang Bang Fire - Head of military
   Knower - Head of knowledge preservation
   Fixer - Head of engineering
   Healer - Head of medical and cloning  
 And you - the new  Watcher .
 
 Your role is unique. You have the great privilege of reliving and interpreting the memories of the ALLMOTHER through a process known as Communion, made possible by Secretary, your floating AI companion.
 
  
 
 As the game begins, you are excited to embark on your first Communion.
 
  
 But all is not well.
 
 Your closest sister, Fixer, comes to you with a dangerous revelation. You have been lied to. The ALLMOTHER is not what she claims to be.
 
 Fixer’s claims rock the foundations of your world, throwing everything you know and believe into doubt.
 
 After Fixer is executed for her treason, it falls to you to discover the truth.
 
  
 
  
 Dive into the memories of the ALLMOTHER.
 
 Explore pivotal moments in her life from high school days and the arrival of the Occupants to the creation of the Orchard and the birth of the first sisters.
 
 Jump back and forth through moments in time within these memories to solve puzzles and access locked off areas and secrets.
 
  
 
 In between Communions, explore the Orchard - a large underground hub area which houses you and your sisters, has many characters to speak to, and holds many things to uncover.
 
 Find the truth and reclaim your legacy.
 
  
 Experience perspective shifts both literal and metaphorical as the game blends between 3rd person adventure, visual novel and first person walking simulator while throwing twists, turns and revelations at you until you question everything you think you know.
 
  
 
 Born from an eclectic set of inspirations, including the games of Yoko Taro (NieR:Automata), the anime of Satoshi Kon (Perfect Blue) and Naoko Yamada (A Silent Voice), and even the theatre of Robert Wilson (Einstein on the Beach), 1000xRESIST tells a story in ways only a game can while simultaneously bringing fresh ideas to interactive storytelling from theatre, dance, performance art, and cinema.
 
  
 Enjoy more than 10 hours of playtime brought to life with over 15,000 lines of fully voiced dialogue from a brilliant cast of Asian-Canadian actors and an incredible soundtrack from two composers.
 
  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675830/1000xRESIST/  ABOUT THE DEVELOPER 
  
 
 1000xRESIST is created by sunset visitor 斜陽過客, an independent studio based in Vancouver (Canada) dedicated to telling diverse stories through the lens of speculative fiction. We are a group of majority Asian-Canadian diaspora creators with a decade of experience in dance, theatre, music, film, visual arts, and new media arts, bringing our background in the experimental performing arts to interactive media.

game.title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.1 Onikakushi
game.description:
*THE GAME THAT INSPIRED THE MEGA-HIT ANIME SERIES 
 RETURNS WITH BRAND NEW CHARACTER ART!! * 
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 The 58th year of Shouwa, early summer.

 It’s June, and the summer heat has arrived earlier than it does most years.
 By day there are crickets, and by night there are cicadas.
 
 We’re in Hinamizawa, a small village in the countryside.
 There are fewer than two thousand people here. But every year, there is an event.
 
 This event is a mysterious death.
 (The series has run from 1979 to 1983)
 
 On a certain day in June, someone dies, and someone else goes missing.
 The series of deaths is connected to the upheaval surrounding the dam construction project.
 A murder case that was covered up is being reenacted.
 Is it a conspiracy? A coincidence? Or perhaps a curse?
 
 Someone who was supposed to be there isn’t.
 Someone who wasn’t supposed to be there is.
 
 Someone who was alive last night is dead now.
 And someone who is here right now isn’t alive.
 
 So, there is no way to avert tragedy. There is no choice but to give up.
 But don’t give up.
 
 Only you can stand up to this.

昭和５８年初夏。

game.title: Spiritfarer: Farewell Edition
game.description:
What will you leave behind? 
  
Spiritfarer is a cozy management game about dying. You play Stella, ferrymaster to the deceased, a Spiritfarer. Build a boat to explore the world, then befriend and care for spirits before finally releasing them into the afterlife. Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, and craft your way across mystical seas. Join the adventure as Daffodil the cat, in two-player cooperative play. Spend relaxing quality time with your spirit passengers, create lasting memories, and, ultimately, learn how to say goodbye to your cherished friends. What will you leave behind?
 
 The Spiritfarer Farewell Edition is the definitive edition of the award-winning cozy management game about dying. It brings together the base game beloved by over 1 million players, and all the additional content released to date. See why critics called Spiritfarer one of the Best Games of 2020.
 
        Features: 
   
• Enjoy beautiful hand-drawn art and animation.
 • Build, manage, and improve your own ferry. 
  • Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, weave, craft! An endless variety of activities await you!
  • Meet, take on board, care for, and forge relationships with a cast of memorable characters.
   • Run, jump, and glide your way through elegantly constructed platforming levels. 
   • Explore a fantastic and imaginative world. Seek and gather resources to craft upgrades for your ship and gifts for your passengers. 
   • Experience moving, emotional stories filled with unforgettable moments.
   • Unwind for hours into cozy and relaxing gameplay. 30 hours to finish, 50+ to experience everything Spiritfarer has to offer.
   • Make the adventure your own with rich customization options for your boat, character, even the cat!
    • Play as Daffodil the cat in optional local co-op. Supports Remote Play Together. 
    • Includes the heartwarming base game and three major content updates: explore an expanded world and befriend four new spirit friends!

What will you leave behind? 
  
Spiritfarer is a cozy management game about dying. You play Stella, ferrymaster to the deceased, a Spiritfarer. Build a boat to explore the world, then befriend and care for spirits before finally releasing them into the afterlife. Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, and craft your way across mystical seas. Join the adventure as Daffodil the cat, in two-player cooperative play. Spend relaxing quality time with your spirit passengers, create lasting memories, and, ultimately, learn how to say goodbye to your cherished friends. What will you leave behind?
 
 The Spiritfarer Farewell Edition is the definitive edition of the award-winning cozy management game about dying. It brings together the base game beloved by over 1 million players, and all the additional content released to date. See why critics called Spiritfarer one of the Best Games of 2020.
 
        Features: 
   
• Enjoy beautiful hand-drawn art and animation.
 • Build, manage, and improve your own ferry. 
  • Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, weave, craft! An endless variety of activities await you!
  • Meet, take on board, care for, and forge relationships with a cast of memorable characters.
   • Run, jump, and glide your way through elegantly constructed platforming levels.

   • Make the adventure your own with rich customization options for your boat, character, even the cat!
    • Play as Daffodil the cat in optional local co-op. Supports Remote Play Together. 
    • Includes the heartwarming base game and three major content updates: explore an expanded world and befriend four new spirit friends!

¿Qué dejarás atrás? 
  
Spiritfarer es un juego de gestión sobre la muerte. Eres Stella, guía de los espíritus, y la maestre de un ferri que transporta a los muertos. Construye un barco para explorar el mundo, hazte amiga de los espíritus y cuida de ellos antes de guiarlos hasta el más allá. Cultiva, extrae recursos, pesca, cosecha, cocina y fabrica en los mares místicos. Únete a la aventura como el gato Daffodil en el modo cooperativo para dos jugadores. Diviértete y relájate con los espíritus pasajeros, crea recuerdos inolvidables y aprende a despedirte de los que más quieres.
 
  La edición Farewell de Spiritfarer es la edición definitiva de este juego de gestión sobre la muerte. Te ofrece el juego base que ya ha cautivado a más de un millón de jugadores, además de todo el contenido adicional publicado hasta la fecha. Descubre por qué Spiritfarer es uno de los mejores juegos del 2020 según la crítica.
 
Características: 
   
• Disfruta de gráficos y animaciones diseñados a mano.
   • Construye, gestiona y mejora tu propio ferri. 
   • ¡Cultiva, extrae recursos, pesca, cosecha, cocina, teje, fabrica y mucho más! ¡Hay un montón de actividades distintas esperándote!
   • Conoce a un gran elenco de personajes memorables, súbelos a bordo, cuídalos y forja relaciones con ellos.
   • Corre, salta y ábrete camino por exquisitos niveles de plataforma. 
   • Explora un fantástico mundo como jamás habías imaginado. Busca y reúne recursos para crear mejoras para tu barco y regalos para los pasajeros. 
   • Vive emotivas historias, plagadas de momentos inolvidables.
   • Sumérgete durante horas en un mundo tranquilo y agradable. Acabarlo te llevará unas 30 horas, pero necesitarás muchísimas más para experimentar todo lo que Spiritfarer puede ofrecerte.
   • Aprovecha al máximo las opciones de personalización para el barco, tu personaje ¡e incluso el gato!
   • Juega como el gato Daffodil en el modo cooperativo local opcional.
   • Incluye el magnífico juego base y tres actualizaciones de contenido muy importantes: ¡explora un mundo mayor y traba amistad con las nuevas almas!

Que restera-t-il de vous ? 
  
Spiritfarer est un jeu de gestion cosy sur le thème de la mort, dans lequel vous incarnez Stella la Navigatrice, une passeuse d’âmes. Construisez un bateau pour explorer le monde, puis liez-vous d’amitié avec les esprits et prenez soin d’eux avant de les mener vers l’au-delà. Cultivez, prospectez, pêchez, récoltez, cuisinez et fabriquez tout ce dont vous aurez besoin pour traverser des mers mystiques. Vous pouvez également incarner Daffodil le chat pour une aventure en mode coopératif à deux joueurs. Partagez des moments privilégiés avec vos défunts passagers, façonnez des souvenirs inoubliables et apprenez comment dire adieu à vos chers amis.
 
  L'édition Farewell de Spiritfarer est l'édition définitive du jeu primé de gestion cosy sur le thème de la mort. Elle inclut le jeu de base tant adoré par près de 1 million de joueurs, et tous les contenus supplémentaires publiés à ce jour. Découvrez pourquoi la critique a désigné Spiritfarer comme l'un des meilleurs jeux de 2020.
 
Caractéristiques : 
   
• De superbes animations et graphismes dessinés à la main.
   • Construisez, gérez et améliorez votre bateau. 
   • Cultivez, prospectez, pêchez, récoltez, cuisinez, tissez et fabriquez ce dont vous avez besoin. C’est tout un éventail d’activités qui vous attend !
   • Rencontrez de nombreux personnages hauts en couleur, prenez-les à bord et sous votre aile, et liez-vous d’amitié avec eux.
   • Courez, sautez et glissez à travers des niveaux de plateforme à la conception élégante. 
   • Explorez un monde imaginaire fantastique. Trouvez et collectez des ressources pour améliorer votre bateau et fabriquer des cadeaux pour vos passagers. 
   • Vivez des histoires émouvantes remplies de moments inoubliables.
   • Détendez-vous au long de nombreuses heures de jeu. Il vous en faudra trente pour arriver à la fin, et plus de 50 pour découvrir tout ce que Spiritfarer a à vous offrir.
   • Façonnez l’aventure à votre goût grâce aux nombreuses possibilités de personnalisation du bateau, de votre personnage, et même du chat !
   • Incarnez Daffodil le chat en mode coopératif local. Remote Play supporté!  
    • Inclut le jeu de base émouvant et trois mises à jour de contenu majeures : explorez un monde étendu et liez-vous d'amitié avec quatre nouveaux esprits !

Was wirst du zurücklassen? 
  
Spiritfarer ist ein gemütliches Management-Spiel über das Sterben. Du spielst Stella, den Fährmann der Verstorbenen, ein sogenannter Spiritfarer. Baue ein Boot, um die Welt zu erkunden. Freunde dich dann mit Geistern an und kümmere dich um sie, bevor du sie schließlich ins Jenseits entlässt. Bebaue Felder, betreibe Minen, fische, ernte, koche und finde deinen Weg über mystische Meere. Schließe dich dem Abenteuer im kooperativen Modus für zwei Spieler als Daffodil die Katze an. Verbringe eine entspannte, tolle Zeit mit deinen Geisterpassagieren, erschaffe bleibende Erinnerungen und lerne schließlich, deinen geschätzten Freunden Lebewohl zu sagen.
 
  Die Farewell-Edition von Spiritfarer ist die vollständige Edition des preisgekrönten gemütlichen Management-Spiels über das Sterben. Es bietet das von über einer Million Spielern geliebte Grundspiel und alle bisher veröffentlichten zusätzlichen Inhalte. Erlebe selbst, warum Spiritfarer von der Kritik als eines der besten Spiele des Jahres 2020 gefeiert wurde.
 
        Features: 

   • Genieße wunderschöne, handgemalte Grafik und Animation.
   • Baue, manage und verbessere deine eigene Fähre 
   • Bebaue Felder, betreibe Minen, fische, ernte, koche, webe und fertige Objekte. Eine unbegrenzte Vielzahl an Aktivitäten erwartet dich!
   • Triff unvergessliche Charaktere, hol sie an Bord, sorge für sie und baue Beziehungen zu ihnen auf.
   • Laufe, springe und gleite auf deinem Weg durch elegant konstruierte Plattform-Levels. 
   • Erkunde eine fantastische und fantasievolle Welt. Suche und sammle Ressourcen, um Verbesserungen für dein Schiff und Geschenke für deine Passagiere herzustellen. 
   • Erlebe bewegende, emotionale Geschichten voller unvergesslicher Momente.
   • Verbringe eine angenehme und entspannende Spielzeit: 30 Stunden bis zum Abschluss und mehr als 50 weitere, um alles zu entdecken, was Spiritfarer zu bieten hat.
   • Mache das Abenteuer mit reichhaltigen Anpassungsmöglichkeiten für dein Boot, deinen Charakter und sogar für die Katze zu deinem eigenen Erlebnis!
   • Spiele im optionalen lokalen Koop-Modus als Daffodil die Katze.

O que deixarás para trás? 
  
Spiritfarer é um acolhedor jogo de gestão sobre a morte. És Stella, a timoneira do ferry dos mortos, também conhecida como Spiritfarer. Cuida dos amigáveis espíritos que conheceres, melhora o teu ferry para explorar o mundo e guia os espíritos até os libertares no pós-vida. Planta, explora minas, pesca, colhe, cozinha e cria através dos mares místicos. Junta-te à aventura na pele de Daffodil, o gato, no modo cooperativo para dois jogadores. Relaxa junto dos espíritos que transportas, cria memórias duradouras e, eventualmente, aprende a dizer adeus aos teus amigos.
 
  Spiritfarer Edição Farewell é a versão definitiva do acolhedor e premiado jogo de gestão sobre a morte. Junta o jogo base que cativou mais de 1 milhão de jogadores e todos os conteúdos adicionais lançados até à data. Fica a saber o que levou os críticos a aclamá-lo como um dos melhores jogos de 2020.
 
        Caraterísticas: 
   
• Desfruta de visuais e animação belíssimos desenhados à mão.
   • Cria, gere e melhora o teu próprio ferry. 
   • Planta, explora minas, pesca, colhe, cozinha, tece, cria! Esperam por ti inúmeras atividades!
   • Conhece, transporta, cuida e trava amizades com um elenco cheio de personagens memoráveis.
   • Corre, salta e desliza através dos elegantes níveis de plataformas. 
   • Explora um mundo de fantasia e imaginação. Procura e obtém recursos para criar melhorias para o ferry e prendas para os passageiros. 
   • Fica a conhecer histórias emocionantes cheias de momentos memoráveis.
   • Relaxa por horas a fio com a sua jogabilidade acolhedora. O jogo dura 30 horas, mas precisarás de mais de 50 para descobrires tudo aquilo que tem para oferecer.
   • Dá um toque pessoal à aventura graças às inúmeras opções de personalização do ferry, da personagem e até do gato!
   • Entra na pele do gato Daffodil no modo cooperativo local opcional.
   • Inclui o cativante jogo base e três grandes atualizações de conteúdos: explora um mundo ainda maior e fica a conhecer quatro novos espíritos amigáveis!

Hvad vil du efterlade? 

  Spiritfarer er et hyggeligt management-spil om at dø. Du spiller Stella, færgemand for de døde, en Spiritfarer. Byg en båd for at udforske verden, find åndevenner og tage dig af dem, før du til sidst frigiver dem til livet efter døden. Lav gård- og minearbejde, høst, fisk og lav mad, og brug dine evner til at kommer over mystiske vande. Gå ind i eventyret som katten Daffodil i et samarbejdsspil for to spillere. Tag lidt afslappende kvalitetstid med dine åndepassagerer, skab varige minder, og lær i sidste ende at sige farvel dine elskede venner.
 
  Spiritfarer Farewell Edition er den definitive udgave af det prisvindende hyggelige management-spil om at dø. Det samler basisspillet, der er elsket af over 1 million spillere, og alt det ekstra indhold, der er udgivet til dato. Se, hvorfor kritikere kaldte Spiritfarer for et af de bedste spil i 2020.
 
        Funktioner: 

   • Nyd smuk håndtegnet grafik og animation.
   • Byg, styr og forbedr din egen færge. 
   • Lav gård- og minearbejde, fisk, høst og lav mad, vævning og håndværk! En endeløs række af aktiviteter venter dig!
   • Mød, byd ombord, tag dig af, og opbyg venskaber med en række mindeværdige figurer.
   • Løb, spring, og glid dig vej igennem elegant konstruerede platformniveauer. 
   • Udforsk en forrygende og fantasifuld verden. Søg og saml ressourcer for at fremstille opgraderinger af dit skib og gaver til dine passagerer. 
   • Oplev bevægende, følelsesladede historer fyldt med uforglemmelige øjeblikke.
   • Slap af i timevis i hyggeligt og afslappende gameplay. 30 timer til at fuldføre, +50 til at opleve alt det, Spiritfarer kan tilbyde.
   • Gør eventyret til dit eget med masser af tilpasningsmuligheder til din båd og figur, ja selv til katten!
   • Spil som katten Daffodil i valgfri, lokal samarbejdsspil.
   • Indeholder det hjertevarmende basisspil og tre store indholdsopdateringer: Udforsk en udvidet verden og bliv venner med fire nye spirituelle venner!

Cosa ti lascerai alle spalle? 

  Spiritfarer è un placido gioco gestionale sul tema della morte. Nel ruolo di Stella, traghettatrice dei defunti, costruisci una barca per esplorare il mondo, quindi prenditi cura degli spiriti fino a condurli all’agognato oltrevita. Coltiva, estrai, pesca, raccogli, cucina e crea per riuscire ad attraversare i mari mistici. Unisciti all’avventura nel ruolo di Daffodil il gatto per giocare in modalità cooperativa. Trascorri del tempo con i tuoi passeggeri, stringendo legami che non dimenticherai, fino ad arrivare a porgere l’ultimo saluto ai tuoi eterni amici.
 
  L'Edizione Farewell di Spiritfarer è la versione definitiva del premiato gestionale sul tema della morte. Include il gioco base, apprezzato da oltre un milione di giocatori, e tutti i contenuti aggiuntivi pubblicati finora. Scopri perché la critica ha considerato Spiritfarer uno dei migliori giochi del 2020.
 
        Caratteristiche: 

   • Disegni e animazioni realizzati a mano.
   • Costruisci, gestisci e migliora la tua barca. 
   • Coltiva, estrai, pesca, raccogli, cucina, intessi e crea! Una lunga serie di attività ti attendono!
   • Accogli a bordo e impara a conoscere un cast di personaggi memorabili.
   • Corri, salta e plana attraverso livelli platform di rara eleganza. 
   • Esplora un mondo fantastico e sorprendente, quindi raccogli risorse per creare potenziamenti per la tua barca e doni per i tuoi passeggeri. 
   • Ripercorri storie di vita emozionanti, piene di momenti indimenticabili.
   • Abbandonati ai ritmi di un gameplay rilassante. Il gioco richiede circa 30 ore per giungere alla fine, e più di 50 per scoprire tutto quanto ha da offrire.
   • Rendi unica la tua avventura personalizzando la barca, la protagonista e persino il gatto!
   • Gioca nel ruolo di Daffodil nella modalità cooperativa locale. 
   • Include il gioco base e tre aggiornamenti pieni di contenuti: esplora un mondo sempre più ampio e conosci quattro nuovi spiriti!

Spiritfarer is a cozy management game about dying. As ferrymaster to the deceased, build a boat to explore the world, care for your spirit friends, and release them into the afterlife. The Spiritfarer Farewell Edition includes the heartwarming base game and three major content updates.

game.brief:
What will you leave behind? 
  
Spiritfarer is a cozy management game about dying. You play Stella, ferrymaster to the deceased, a Spiritfarer. Build a boat to explore the world, then befriend and care for spirits before finally releasing them into the afterlife. Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, and craft your way across mystical seas. Join the adventure as Daffodil the cat, in two-player cooperative play. Spend relaxing quality time with your spirit passengers, create lasting memories, and, ultimately, learn how to say goodbye to your cherished friends. What will you leave behind?
 
 The Spiritfarer Farewell Edition is the definitive edition of the award-winning cozy management game about dying. It brings together the base game beloved by over 1 million players, and all the additional content released to date. See why critics called Spiritfarer one of the Best Games of 2020.
 
        Features: 
   
• Enjoy beautiful hand-drawn art and animation.
 • Build, manage, and improve your own ferry. 
  • Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, weave, craft! An endless variety of activities await you!
  • Meet, take on board, care for, and forge relationships with a cast of memorable characters.
   • Run, jump, and glide your way through elegantly constructed platforming levels. 
   • Explore a fantastic and imaginative world. Seek and gather resources to craft upgrades for your ship and gifts for your passengers. 
   • Experience moving, emotional stories filled with unforgettable moments.
   • Unwind for hours into cozy and relaxing gameplay. 30 hours to finish, 50+ to experience everything Spiritfarer has to offer.
   • Make the adventure your own with rich customization options for your boat, character, even the cat!
    • Play as Daffodil the cat in optional local co-op. Supports Remote Play Together. 
    • Includes the heartwarming base game and three major content updates: explore an expanded world and befriend four new spirit friends!

game.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
game.description:
Trained from early childhood and mutated to gain superhuman skills, strength, and reflexes, witchers are a counterbalance to the monster-infested world in which they live.

• Gruesomely destroy foes as a professional monster hunter armed with a range of upgradeable weapons, mutating potions, and combat magic.
• Hunt down a wide variety of exotic monsters, from savage beasts prowling mountain passes to cunning supernatural predators lurking in the shadowy back alleys of densely populated cities.
• Invest your rewards to upgrade your weaponry and buy custom armor, or spend them on horse races, card games, fist fighting, and other pleasures life brings.
  
Built for endless adventure, the massive open world of The Witcher sets new standards in terms of size, depth, and complexity.

• Traverse a fantastical open world: explore forgotten ruins, caves, and shipwrecks, trade with merchants and dwarven smiths in cities, and hunt across the open plains, mountains, and seas.
• Deal with treasonous generals, devious witches, and corrupt royalty to provide dark and dangerous services.
• Make choices that go beyond good & evil, and face their far-reaching consequences.
  
Take on the most important contract of your life: to track down the child of prophecy, the key to saving or destroying this world.

• In times of war, chase down the child of prophecy, a living weapon foretold by ancient elven legends.
• Struggle against ferocious rulers, spirits of the wilds, and even a threat from beyond the veil – all hell-bent on controlling this world.
• Define your destiny in a world that may not be worth saving.

《巫师3：狂猎》将是三部曲系列的最后一作，故事将有宏大的最后结局，但并非《巫师》系列的最终作。本作采用最新的REDengine3引擎制作，玩家可以在无缝的世界里任意探索，采用非线性剧情的设定，整体规模是前作的30倍。

《巫师3：狂猎》是一款由波兰游戏工作室CD Projekt RED开发并发行的开放世界动作角色扮演游戏，于2013年2月公布。游戏于2015年5月19日在Microsoft Windows、PlayStation 4和Xbox One平台发布，这也是首款在PlayStation平台发布的巫师系列游戏。

本作是巫师系列的第三部作品，同样改编自波兰奇幻小说作家安杰伊·萨普科夫斯基的同名系列小说（中译《猎魔人》），但剧情发生在小说之后。游戏在商业上取得了成功并受到了广泛的赞誉，在六周内销量超过600万，亦获得2015年游戏大奖的最佳年度游戏，以及最佳角色扮演游戏。

本作是一款情节驱动的开放世界角色扮演游戏。故事发生在一个令人目眩神迷的奇幻宇宙里，玩家做出的每一个选择都意义重大，同时也要面对影响深远的后果。在《巫师》这个广袤的开放世界中，您可以尽情探索商业都市、海盗岛屿、危险的山隘和被遗忘的洞窟。而随着北方领域战乱四起，您接下了此生最为重大的一笔委托：找到预言之子，一件足以改变世界面貌的活生生的武器。

◇ 扮演一名训练有素，收钱办事的怪物杀手
猎魔人身处的世界怪物横行。作为一支制衡力量，他们自小接受训练，通过变异来获得超人类的战斗技巧、力量和反应。
扮演一名职业怪物杀手，装备一系列可以升级的武器、变种魔药和战斗法术，无情地把对手大卸八块。
凶残的野兽徘徊于山间，狡猾的灵异掠食者潜伏在人烟稠密的城镇暗处，而您则要捕杀这些各色的奇异怪物。
把您赚取的奖赏用来升级武器，购买订制的盔甲，或者花在赛马、打牌、拳击，还有其它的夜间娱乐生活上。

◇ 探索道德沦丧的开放式奇幻世界
巫师宏大的开放世界为玩家带来无尽的冒险，并且在规模、深度和复杂性等方面树立了新的标准。
遍历奇幻的开放世界：探索被遗忘的废墟、洞穴和沉船，与城市里的商人和矮人工匠做买卖，在开阔的平原、山地和海洋上进行狩猎。
与谋反的将领、阴险的女巫还有腐败的皇室打交道，替他们去完成见不得光的危险勾当。
做出超越善恶的选择，直面影响深远的后果。

◇ 追寻预言之子
接下最为重要的一笔委托，追寻预言之子。那是一个可以拯救或是摧毁这个世界的关键。
根据古代精灵的预言，预言之子强大无比，是一件活生生的武器。而您则要在纷飞的战火中找到对方的下落。
和一心想要控制这个世界的残暴统治者、野外的精怪，乃至于来自来世的威胁斗智斗勇。
在这个或许并不值得拯救的世界里，左右自己的命运。

◇ 次世代机能的全面发挥
专为次世代硬件量身打造的 REDengine 3，把《巫师》的逼真奇幻世界渲染得细腻生动。
动态的天气系统和日夜循环，将会改变城镇居民以及野外怪兽的行为模式。
通过主线和支线的丰富剧情选择，玩家可以通过前所未有的方式，影响这个宏大的开放世界。

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is an open-world action role-playing game developed by CD Projekt Red.

Set in a dark fantasy world, the game follows Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter searching for his adopted daughter, Ciri, while navigating political conflicts and supernatural threats. Gameplay features exploration, combat, character progression, and branching narratives shaped by player choices. Widely acclaimed for its writing, world-building, and depth, it is considered one of the most influential RPGs of its generation.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt concludes the story of the witcher Geralt of Rivia, the series' protagonist, whose story to date has been covered in the previous installments. Geralt's new mission comes in dark times as the mysterious and otherworldly army known as the Wild Hunt invades the Northern Kingdoms, leaving only blood soaked earth and fiery ruin in its wake; and it seems the Witcher is the key to stopping their cataclysmic rampage.

  Du bist Geralt von Riva, Monsterschlächter und Söldner. Vor dir erstreckt sich ein vom Krieg zerrütteter und von Monstern befallener Kontinent, den du nach Belieben erkunden kannst. Dein aktueller Auftrag? Finde Ciri, das Kind der Prophezeiung – eine lebende Waffe mit der Macht, die Welt zu verändern.
  
  Mit dem Update auf die neueste Version beinhaltet The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt neue Features und Extras wie den integrierten Fotomodus, neue Gegenstände (Schwerter, Rüstung, alternative Outfits), die von der Netflix-Serie The Witcher inspiriert wurden, und noch mehr!
  
   
  Erlebe die düstere Fantasy-Welt des Kontinents wie nie zuvor! Diese Edition von The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt beinhaltet zahlreiche grafische und technische Verbesserungen, darunter viel höhere Detaildichte, mehrere neu entwickelte oder von der Community geschaffene Mods, Echtzeit-Raytracing und mehr – alles mit Blick auf die Leistungsstärke modernder PCs umgesetzt!
  
   
  Hexer wurden seit ihrer Kindheit trainiert und durchliefen Mutationen, um übermenschliche Fähigkeiten, Stärke und Reflexe zu erlangen – nur so haben sie eine Chance gegen die Monster ihrer Welt.
  • Zerstöre deine Gegner als professioneller Monsterjäger, der mit verschiedenen Waffen, Mutationstränken und Kampfmagie ausgestattet ist.
  • Jage eine Vielzahl exotischer Monster, von wilden Bestien an Bergpässen bis hin zu gerissenen übernatürlichen Raubtieren, die in den dunklen Gassen dicht besiedelter Städte lauern.
  • Nutze deine Belohnungen, um deine Waffen zu verbessern und besondere Rüstungen zu kaufen, oder gib dein Geld für Pferderennen, Kartenspiele, Faustkämpfe und sonstige Unterhaltung aus.
  
   
  Die riesige Open World von The Witcher bietet dir endlose Abenteuer und setzt neue Maßstäbe, was Größe, Tiefe und Komplexität angeht.
  • Durchquere eine fantastische Welt: Erkunde vergessene Ruinen, Höhlen und Schiffswracks, handle mit Kaufleuten und zwergischen Schmieden in Städten und jage auf Ebenen, in Bergen und auf dem Meer.
  • Triff auf hinterhältige Generäle, verschlagene Hexen und korrupte Adlige, denen du gefährliche Dienste anbietest.
  • Triff Entscheidungen, die nicht einfach gut oder böse sind und weitreichende Konsequenzen haben.

  • Spüre mitten im Krieg das Kind der Prophezeiung auf, eine lebende Waffe aus uralten elfischen Legenden.

game.brief:
Trained from early childhood and mutated to gain superhuman skills, strength, and reflexes, witchers are a counterbalance to the monster-infested world in which they live.

• Gruesomely destroy foes as a professional monster hunter armed with a range of upgradeable weapons, mutating potions, and combat magic.
• Hunt down a wide variety of exotic monsters, from savage beasts prowling mountain passes to cunning supernatural predators lurking in the shadowy back alleys of densely populated cities.
• Invest your rewards to upgrade your weaponry and buy custom armor, or spend them on horse races, card games, fist fighting, and other pleasures life brings.
  
Built for endless adventure, the massive open world of The Witcher sets new standards in terms of size, depth, and complexity.

• Traverse a fantastical open world: explore forgotten ruins, caves, and shipwrecks, trade with merchants and dwarven smiths in cities, and hunt across the open plains, mountains, and seas.
• Deal with treasonous generals, devious witches, and corrupt royalty to provide dark and dangerous services.
• Make choices that go beyond good & evil, and face their far-reaching consequences.
  
Take on the most important contract of your life: to track down the child of prophecy, the key to saving or destroying this world.

• In times of war, chase down the child of prophecy, a living weapon foretold by ancient elven legends.
• Struggle against ferocious rulers, spirits of the wilds, and even a threat from beyond the veil – all hell-bent on controlling this world.
• Define your destiny in a world that may not be worth saving.

game.title: Chants of Sennaar
game.description:
Winner of Best Indie Game at the 2024 New York Game Awards and nominated multiple times at other ceremonies including The Game Awards and the BAFTA, Chants of Sennaar is a critically-acclaimed puzzle and adventure game developed by Rundisc.
 
 Divided since the dawn of time, the Peoples of the Tower no longer speak to each other, isolated by fear or mistrust. It is said that one day, a Traveler will find the wisdom to break down the walls and restore the balance. Travel the endless steps of a prodigious labyrinth, uncover the truth and unveil the mysteries of this fascinating universe where ancient languages are both the lock and the key.

 Inspired by the myth of Babel, discover an enigmatic and vast tower. As the Traveler, delve into a world full of mysteries, where Peoples have grown distant, unable to communicate with each other anymore. Begin your adventure in a prodigious tower inhabited by five distinct Peoples, observe, listen, and strive to mend the bonds of distrust. 
  
 With a smart gameplay system, explore and solve various puzzles to uncover the mysteries of five different interconnected languages. Always guided by your trusty notebook, note each symbol, keep track of your surroundings, engage in conversations with people and unravel the meaning of every glyph. Each step will pave your way to the top of the Tower as each word will restore the link between People.
  
 Dive into an enthralling and colorful world full of secrets. Tumble headlong into a beautiful world inspired by impactful European comics authors where every floor of the Tower possesses its own visual identity, supported by distinctive technological levels, architecture and culture. Embark on a poetic and enchanting journey driven by a soul-stirring, lyrical soundtrack, made by Thomas Brunet.

Chants of Sennaar es un juego de aventuras y puzles desarrollado por Rundisc y distribuido por Focus Entertainment. Ha recibido grandes elogios por parte de la crítica y el premio al Mejor Juego Independiente en los New York Game Awards 2024, además de diversas nominaciones a otros premios como los BAFTA y The Game Awards.
 
 Divididos desde el albor de los tiempos, aislados por miedo o desconfianza, los pueblos de la torre ya no se hablan. Mas cuenta la leyenda que un viajero sabrá derribar los muros y recuperar el equilibrio. Recorre los infinitos caminos de un laberinto prodigioso, averigua la verdad y desvela los misterios de este universo fascinante en el que antiguos idiomas son tanto puerta como llave.

 Descubre una enorme y enigmática torre inspirada en el mito de Babel. Encarna al viajero y sumérgete en un mundo lleno de misterios donde las gentes se han distanciado y ya no son capaces de comunicarse entre ellas. Empieza la aventura en una torre prodigiosa habitada por cinco pueblos diferentes, observa, escucha e intenta rehacer los vínculos que ha roto la desconfianza.

 Disfruta de un ingenioso sistema de juego, explora y resuelve puzles para revelar los secretos de cinco idiomas distintos pero relacionados. Con la ayuda de tu fiel cuaderno, toma nota de cada símbolo, lleva un registro del entorno, habla con la gente y desentraña el significado de los glifos. Cada paso será un peldaño en el ascenso a la torre y cada palabra un eslabón en los vínculos entre las gentes.

 Sumérgete en un lugar colorido y cautivador lleno de secretos. Lánzate a un mundo hermoso inspirado por prestigiosos autores de cómic europeos en el que cada nivel de la torre cuenta con una identidad visual propia y una tecnología, arquitectura y cultura características. Emprende un viaje apasionante y poético con una banda sonora lírica y conmovedora compuesta por Thomas Brunet.

Nommé meilleur jeu indépendant aux New York Game Awards 2024 et nominé à de nombreuses reprises lors d'autres événements (notamment The Game Awards et les BAFTA), Chants of Sennaar est un jeu d'aventure à énigmes salué par la critique. Il est développé par Rundisc.
 
 Divisés depuis la nuit des temps, isolés par la peur ou la méfiance, les Peuples de la Tour ne se parlent plus. On dit qu'un jour, un voyageur d'une grande sagesse brisera ces murs de défiance et rétablira l'équilibre. Grimpez les escaliers interminables d'un extraordinaire labyrinthe, découvrez la vérité et levez le voile sur les mystères de cet univers fascinant où les langues anciennes constituent à la fois des obstacles et des solutions. 

 Découvrez une tour aussi imposante qu'énigmatique dans ce jeu qui s'inspire du mythe de la Tour de Babel. Dans le rôle du Voyageur, plongez dans un monde de mystères où les peuples se sont éloignés les uns avec les autres, au point de ne plus pouvoir communiquer entre eux. Commencez l'aventure dans cette tour prodigieuse habitée par cinq peuplades très différentes. Observez, écoutez et faites tout votre possible pour rétablir la confiance d'autrefois.

 Avec son gameplay astucieux, le jeu vous permettra d'explorer les lieux et de résoudre diverses énigmes pour élucider les mystères de cinq langues à la fois distinctes et liées les unes aux autres. Prenez des notes sur les symboles et l'environnement dans votre fidèle carnet, engagez la conversation avec différentes personnes et découvrez la signification de tous les glyphes. À chaque pas qui vous rapprochera du sommet de la tour, les mots vous permettront de rétablir les liens entre les peuples.

 Plongez-vous dans un monde haut en couleur regorgeant de secrets. Explorez des environnements sublimes qui s'inspirent de bandes dessinées européennes, chaque étage de la tour ayant une identité visuelle, un niveau technologique, une architecture et une culture qui lui sont propres. Embarquez-vous dans un voyage poétique et enchanteur au son d'une bande originale lyrique et émouvante composée par Thomas Brunet.

Das bei den New York Game Awards 2024 als bestes Indie-Spiel ausgezeichnete und bei anderen Preisverleihungen wie The Game Awards und BAFTA mehrfach nominierte Chants of Sennaar ist ein von der Kritik hochgelobtes Rätsel- und Abenteuerspiel, das von Rundisc entwickelt wurde.
 
 Die seit Anbeginn der Zeit durch Angst und Misstrauen voneinander isolierten Völker des Turms kommunizieren nicht mehr miteinander. Es heißt, dass eines Tages ein Reisender die Weisheit finden wird, die Mauern niederzureißen und das Gleichgewicht wiederherzustellen. Erklimme die endlosen Stufen eines gewaltigen Labyrinths, entdecke die Wahrheit und lüfte die Geheimnisse dieses faszinierenden Universums, in dem die uralten Sprachen Schlüssel und Schloss zugleich sind.

 Erkunde einen gewaltigen vom Mythos von Babel inspirierten Turm voller Rätsel. Als Reisender tauchst du in eine geheimnisvolle Welt ein, in der sich die Völker immer weiter voneinander entfernt haben und nicht mehr in der Lage sind, sich zu verständigen. Beginne dein Abenteuer in einem riesigen Turm, der von fünf verschiedenen Völkern bewohnt wird. Beobachte, lausche und versuche, die vom Misstrauen zerrissenen Bande wiederherzustellen.

 Erkunde den Turm und löse unterschiedliche Rätsel mithilfe eines intelligenten Spielsystems, um die Geheimnisse fünf miteinander verbundener Sprachen zu lüften. Dein treuer Begleiter ist dabei das Notizbuch, in dem du jedes gefundene Symbol notierst. Behalte deine Umgebung im Auge, unterhalte dich mit den Bewohnern und entziffere die Bedeutung aller Glyphen. Mit jedem entschlüsselten Wort stellst du die Verbindung zwischen den Völkern wieder her und kommst der Spitze des Turms ein Stück näher.

 Eine mitreißende, farbenfrohe Welt voller Geheimnisse und Rätsel erwartet dich. Stürze dich kopfüber in eine wunderschöne Spielumgebung, die sich an einflussreichen europäischen Comics orientiert. Jede Ebene des Turms besitzt ihre eigene visuelle Identität, die sich in Form einzigartiger Technologien, Architektur und Kultur äußert. Begib dich auf ein zauberhaftes Abenteuer, das mit einem gefühlvollen lyrischen Soundtrack von Thomas Brunet unterlegt ist.

Vincitore del premio Best Indie Game ai New York Game Awards del 2024 e plurinominato in altre premiazioni tra cui The Game Awards e i BAFTA, Chants of Sennaar è un gioco di avventura e rompicapi acclamato dalla critica, sviluppato da Rundisc.
 
 Separati fin dall'alba del tempo, i Popoli della Torre non comunicano più gli uni con gli altri, isolati dalla paura o dalla sfiducia. Si dice che un giorno verrà un Viaggiatore, e la sua saggezza abbatterà le barriere e ristabilirà l'equilibrio. Viaggia per le scalinate interminabili di un prodigioso labirinto, scopri la verità e svela i misteri di questo universo affascinante in cui le lingue antiche sono insieme chiave e serratura. 

 Scopri una torre enigmatica e vasta, ispirata al mito di Babele. Nei panni del Viaggiatore, esplora un mondo pieno di misteri, dove i Popoli si sono allontanati, ormai incapaci di comunicare tra loro. Inizia la tua avventura in una torre prodigiosa abitata da cinque diversi Popoli: osserva, ascolta e fai ogni sforzo per rinsaldare i legami spezzati dalla sfiducia.

 Grazie al sistema di gameplay intelligente, esplora e risolvi diversi enigmi per scoprire i misteri di cinque diverse lingue interconnesse tra loro. Sotto la guida costante del tuo fedele diario, annota ogni simbolo, tieni traccia dell'ambiente circostante, conversa con le persone e svela il significato di ciascun glifo. Ogni passo in avanti ti porterà verso la vetta della Torre, e ogni parola rinsalderà i legami tra i Popoli.

 Immergiti in un mondo appassionante e pittoresco, colmo di segreti. Tuffati in un mondo magnifico ispirato ai maestri del fumetto europeo dove ciascun piano della Torre ha una sua identità visiva, con tecnologie, architetture e culture ben distinte. Parti per un viaggio poetico e ammaliante accompagnato da una colonna sonora che risuona in fondo all'anima, realizzata da Thomas Brunet.

高塔上的各个民族语言不通由来已久，传说某个旅人某日将破除隔阂，将他们团结起来。走进这座别样而又迷人的巴别塔，仔细观察、聆听，才能破译古代文字。

寻觅往昔的只言片语，揭示过去的秘密 

自从创世之初，高塔各族便已分隔，彼此不再有言语往来，只是据说某日，某位旅人获得了智慧，能够推倒高墙，恢复天道。走进引人入胜的世界，探索缤纷诗意的设定，感受巴别塔传说的奇妙，帮人们忆起往事。置身庞大的迷宫之中，走过无穷无尽的阶梯，揭示苦涩的真相，揭晓迷人世界的秘密。在这里，你会发现：古老的语言既是锁头，也是钥匙。

game.description:
Set sail for adventure in this new installment of the award-winning Monument Valley game series, exploring an expansive and beautiful world of puzzles. 
  
   Begin a thrilling new voyage into an enchanting puzzle world. Guide Noor, a young apprentice, through a world of shifting architecture and rising tides as she seeks to restore the fading light. 
  
   DEFY PERSPECTIVE TO SOLVE PUZZLES 
  Twist gravity. Shift perspectives. Reshape ancient structures. Every puzzle is a new challenge in logic, intuition, and imagination.       
  
   CHANGE THE WORLD AS YOU EXPLORE 
  From serene temples to crumbling ruins, journey through mesmerising environments bursting with colour, mystery, and meaning.
        
   SET SAIL THROUGH RISING TIDES 
  Navigate across shifting seas. Your boat companion is the key to unlocking long-lost secrets and hidden paths.        
  
   THE COMPLETE EXPERIENCE — WITH MORE TO COME 
  Monument Valley 3 includes the full story at launch, with additional puzzles and chapters arriving post-release.     
  
   KEY FEATURES 
   
 • Solve mind-bending puzzles across breathtaking spaces   
 • Discover new environments shaped by illusion and perspective   
 • Experience a rich, emotional journey through impossible geometry and sacred light   
 • Includes all future updates and content at no extra cost.   
   
Add to your wishlist to be the first to continue Noor’s journey as new chapters unfold.

   受賞歴のある『モニュメントバレー』シリーズ最新作で、謎解きの世界へ出航。美しく広がるパズルの世界を探索しましょう。 
  
   胸躍る新たな旅に出て、魅惑的なパズルの世界へ。若き見習いヌーアを導いて、移ろう建築と満ちてゆく潮の世界で消えかけた光を取り戻してください。

   探索が、世界を変えてゆく 
  静寂の神殿から崩れかけた廃墟まで―色彩と謎、そして何らかの意図を持った魅惑の世界を旅しましょう。
  
        
  
   満ちゆく潮を越えて、航海に出発 
  移ろう海を進むにつれ、相棒の小舟が忘れられた秘密と隠された道を解き明かしてくれます。
  
        
  
   完全版を収録―さらに追加コンテンツも続々登場

  • 圧倒的な空間で、心を揺さぶる謎解きに挑戦
 • 錯覚と視点が生み出す新たな世界を発見
 • 不可能な幾何学と神聖な光を巡る、心揺さぶる旅を体験
 • 今後のアップデートやコンテンツはすべて追加費用なしで提供
  
   ウィッシュリストに追加して、新しいチャプターが登場次第ヌーアの冒険を続けよう。 
  
        
  
  ustwo gamesは、受賞歴のある『モニュメントバレー』シリーズ、『Land’s End』、『Assemble with Care』、『Alba: A Wildlife Adventure』で知られる、誇り高きインディー系デベロッパーです。

A thrilling story-driven action RPG, with a rich open world, set in 15th century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure — through the eyes of young Henry — as you embark on a journey of epic proportions.

You are Henry of Skalitz — an ordinary man doing extraordinary things — caught in a gripping tale of revenge, betrayal and discovery as he embarks on an epic journey, 'from a humble blacksmith's forge to the court of Kings', as he searches for purpose in this beautiful but brutal medieval world.

你将扮演来自小村斯卡里茨的亨利——一位做出了不凡之事的凡夫俗子，踏上史诗般的旅程。你将被卷入一段摄人心弦的有关复仇，背叛和发现的故事，这段旅程将带你从一间简陋的铁匠铺一路走进国王的宫廷，在这个美丽而无情的中世纪世界中寻找自己的意义。

从熙熙攘攘的城市街道到郁郁葱葱的森林，通过充满动作、刺激和惊奇的难忘冒险，来探索这个中世纪欧洲的开放世界。

特色

一段有关爱与复仇的故事
从亨利——一个为自己被谋杀的双亲而踏上复仇之旅的年轻人——的角度来体验这个故事。在这段以超过五个小时的精彩剧情描绘的故事当中，他将从一位有抱负的战士蜕变为一名反抗者，在与匈牙利国王、“红狐”西格斯蒙德及其可怕的盟友对抗的过程中，他将与众多魅力十足的角色交织在一起，经历一系列令人难忘的冒险。

一个真正的角色扮演游戏体验

你的行动将塑造亨利的命运，以及世界将会如何看待他。你可以尽情自定义他的长相，技能与装备，同时对发生在他周围的事件采取各种道德立场。在这片土地上旅行，参与诸如打铁与射箭在内的各种独特活动，来真正地融入这片欧洲多姿多彩的土地——同时这片土地也会永久记得你做出的行动。

体验中世纪的人生

游戏令人惊叹地真实重现了 15 世纪的波西米亚，让你可以体验到这里前所未有的迷人风情。迷失在巨大的城市中，和农民以及贵族们交谈互动，并探索有着酒馆、澡堂、城堡以及更多内容的广袤乡间。

真实的第一人称战斗

在惊心动魄的实时作战中，感受钢铁的碰撞和内涵丰富的战斗。游戏中一系列真实的武器和战斗方式适合每一位玩家游玩。你可以在马上或者马下，甚至是潜行战斗；也可以选择优雅的剑术，残忍的钝器或者致命的远程攻击进行专精。

game.title: Palworld
game.description:
Q. What kind of game is this?
 
 A. In this game, you can peacefully live alongside mysterious creatures known as Pals or risk your life to drive off a ruthless poaching syndicate.
 
 Pals can be used to fight, or they can be made to work on farms or factories.
 You can even sell them or eat them! 
 
   Survival  
 In a harsh environment where food is scarce and vicious poachers roam, danger waits around every corner. To survive, you must tread carefully and make difficult choices...even if that means eating your own Pals when the time comes.      
 
   Mounts & Exploration  
 Pals can be mounted to traverse the land, sea and sky—allowing you to traverse all kinds of environment as you explore the world.      
 
   Building Structures  
 Want to build a pyramid? Put an army of Pals on the job. Don't worry; there are no labor laws for Pals.      
 
   Production  
 Make use of Pals and their skills to make fire, generate electricity, or mine ore so that you can live a life of comfort.       
 
   Farming  
 Some Pals are good at planting seeds, while others are skilled at watering or harvesting crops. Work together with your Pals to create an idyllic farmstead.       
 
   Factories & Automation  
 Letting Pals do the work is the key to automation. Build a factory, place a Pal in it, and they'll keep working as long as they're fed—until they're dead, that is.       
 
   Dungeon Exploration  
 With Pals on your side you can tackle even the most dangerous areas. When the time comes, you might have to sacrifice one to save your skin. They'll protect your life—even if it costs their own.       
 
   Breeding & Genetics  
 Breed a Pal and it will inherit the characteristics of its parents. Combine rare pals to create the strongest Pal of them all!      
 
   Poaching & Crime  
 Endangered Pals live in wildlife sanctuaries. Sneak in and capture rare Pals to get rich quick! It's not a crime if you don't get caught, after all.       
 
   Multiplayer  
 Multiplayer is supported, so invite a friend and go on an adventure together! And of course you can battle your friends and trade Pals, too.
 
 In online co-op play mode, up to 4 players can play together.
 Additionally, a dedicated server can allow up to 32 players to play together.
